detail.title: Modern information and analytical support for data economy management
detail.abstract: The article presents the results of a study of current management decisions in the field of implementation of information and analytical support, in particular Business Intelligence (BI) systems. The article examines the functionality of BI systems as a tool for supporting strategic and operational decisions, their role in improving management efficiency, optimizing business processes, reducing costs and achieving the strategic goals of companies. The results of the study of the Business Intelligence functionality allowed the authors to conclude that, despite the high cost of their implementation and the need to adapt such analytical solutions to the specifics of the business, BI systems are an important tool for ensuring sustainable economic growth of companies in the context of digital transformation and significantly contribute to the flexibility and adaptability of the company to changing environmental conditions. The article will be useful for representatives of applied science and practicing managers to familiarize themselves with the essence of BI systems, as well as to justify decisions on their implementation in the management of economic entities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了商业智能(BI)系统作为信息分析支持工具的功能，发现尽管实施成本高且需要定制化，但BI系统能显著提升管理效率、优化业务流程、降低成本，是企业数字化转型中实现可持续经济增长的重要工具。
AI.research_question: BI系统如何作为战略和运营决策支持工具，提升企业管理效率并促进可持续经济增长？
AI.motivation: 在数字化转型背景下，企业需要有效的信息分析支持工具来优化管理决策，BI系统作为重要工具需要深入研究其功能和实施价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息管理系统理论、决策支持系统理论和数字化转型理论，探讨BI系统的功能定位和实施价值。
AI.method: 文献研究和功能分析，系统考察BI系统的功能特性及其在企业管理中的应用效果。
AI.findings: BI系统虽然实施成本高且需要业务定制，但能显著提升管理效率、优化业务流程、降低成本，促进企业灵活适应环境变化，是实现可持续经济增长的重要工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对BI系统在数字化转型中作用的理论认识，丰富了信息管理系统和决策支持系统的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为应用科学研究者和实践管理者提供了BI系统实施的决策依据，帮助企业更好地利用BI系统提升管理效能和适应市场变化。

detail.abstract:
Non-violent revolution in the present time can occur in three ways. They can run concurrently. Or separately. First one, self-reliance — living within the affection of Mother-earth, with hand-in-hand human coordination, by reducing the dominance of money. Second, continuous legal battle to resolve injustice. Identifying and eliminating the illegal elements through the framework of law and regulation. And the final one is the movement that Mahatma Gandhi started in South Africa in 1900. In this third stream of movement, we find the identification of how to be communed while maintaining personal integrity and purity, and how to stand up against social injustice using both of  that collective and personal purity. In today's era, these three streams of movement can equally gain recognition.

The article is written in Bengali, and readers, no matter which country they are from, can translate it into their native language using Meta or Gemini and read it.

title: Quantifying the Distortions of Labor Market Power: U.S. Coal Mines 2001-2019
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Quantifying the Distortions of Labor Market Power: U.S. Coal Mines 2001-2019
detail.abstract: This paper studies labor market power in the coal mining industry using a causal empirical difference-in-differences design and an equilibrium oligopsony model that endogenizes wages, employment, capital, and output. I show that labor oligopsony not only lowers wages and employment, harming workers, but also significantly reduces demand for capital and the production of output, harming investors and consumers.  These complementary distortions of labor market power are four-times larger, by value, than the wage and employment distortions that drive them, suggesting that worker outcomes significantly underestimate the welfare effect of oligopsony in capital-intensive industries like mining.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证研究和均衡模型分析煤炭开采行业的劳动力市场力量，发现劳动力买方垄断不仅降低工资和就业，还显著减少资本需求和产出，对投资者和消费者造成损害。这些补充性扭曲的价值是工资和就业扭曲的四倍。
AI.research_question: 劳动力买方垄断在资本密集型行业（如采矿业）中如何影响工资、就业、资本需求和产出？
AI.motivation: 研究劳动力市场力量在资本密集型行业中的全面影响，特别是买方垄断对工人、投资者和消费者的综合福利效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 均衡寡头垄断模型，内生化工资、就业、资本和产出决策；劳动力买方垄断理论。
AI.method: 因果实证双重差分设计和均衡寡头垄断模型。
AI.findings: 劳动力买方垄断不仅降低工资和就业，还显著减少资本需求和产出；补充性扭曲的价值是工资和就业扭曲的四倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了对劳动力市场力量的理解，揭示了买方垄断在资本密集型行业中的多重扭曲效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估劳动力市场干预措施全面影响的框架，强调了仅关注工人结果会低估买方垄断的福利成本。

detail.abstract: Stress floods the body with hormones that wear it down. Placement gives a practical, body-based way to bring those levels down and restore calm and balance. It combines embodied leadership and structured timing to shift stress chemistry in minutes rather than hours. This paper outlines the biological basis of Placement, compares it to existing somatic methods, and defines its measurable hormonal mechanisms.

title: AI and Business Intelligence Integration: A Critical Factor for Innovation in Manufacturing Industries
affiliations: Arkansas State University

detail.title: AI and Business Intelligence Integration: A Critical Factor for Innovation in Manufacturing Industries

keywords: Artificial Intelligence Smart Manufacturing Machine Learning
Machine Learning Deep Learning Autonomous System

detail.abstract: This scholarly review provides a comprehensive analysis of the synergistic integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Business Intelligence (BI) to optimize operational performance within the manufacturing sector. It underscores AI's pivotal role in revolutionizing strategic decision-making, refining operational workflows, and enhancing value creation mechanisms across diverse manufacturing enterprises. The discourse delves into several critical domains, including the application of AI to augment manufacturing efficiency, the progression of intelligent manufacturing systems, the incorporation of BI frameworks within AI-driven applications, and the utilization of predictive and prescriptive analytics. Furthermore, the review examines the convergence of AI with emerging technologies such as machine learning and advanced analytics, focusing on areas like process optimization, quality assurance, and the development of organizational capabilities. Ethical and responsible AI adoption is emphasized not only as a moral obligation but also as a strategic necessity that bolsters competitiveness and operational agility. The paper offers evidence-based frameworks for practitioners to align AI capabilities with organizational objectives and identifies key avenues for future research, including longitudinal assessments, context-specific implementation strategies, and sustainable innovation pathways. The findings position AI as a catalyst for systemic transformation in manufacturing, necessitating continuous learning, ethical governance, and strategic foresight to sustain competitive advantage in increasingly digitized industrial environments.

title: From Small to Large: A Graph Convolutional Network Approach for Solving Assortment Optimization Problems
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen -School of Data Science, University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business and The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

detail.title: From Small to Large: A Graph Convolutional Network Approach for Solving Assortment Optimization Problems
detail.abstract: Assortment optimization seeks to select a subset of substitutable products, subject to constraints, to maximize expected revenue. The problem is NP-hard due to its combinatorial and nonlinear nature and arises frequently in industries such as e-commerce, where platforms must solve thousands of such problems each minute. We propose a graph convolutional network (GCN) framework to efficiently solve constrained assortment optimization problems. Our approach constructs a graph representation of the problem, trains a GCN to learn the mapping from problem parameters to optimal assortments, and develops three inference policies based on the GCN's output. Owing to the GCN's ability to generalize across instance sizes, patterns learned from small-scale samples can be transferred to large-scale problems. Numerical experiments show that a GCN trained on instances with 20 products achieves over 85% of the optimal revenue on problems with up to 2,000 products within seconds, outperforming existing heuristics in both accuracy and efficiency. We further extend the framework to settings with an unknown choice model using transaction data and demonstrate similar performance and scalability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于图卷积网络(GCN)的框架来解决约束性产品组合优化问题，该框架能够从问题参数到最优产品组合学习映射关系，并在大规模问题上实现高效求解。

AI.findings: 在20个产品实例上训练的GCN，在多达2000个产品的问题上能在几秒内达到超过85%的最优收益，在准确性和效率上都优于现有启发式方法

detail.abstract: The efficiency of Kenya's pension schemes invites elevated interest owing to the increasing pension contribution amounts and the expectation that benefits paid out of these schemes would protect members from old age poverty. The study investigates the intervening effect of risk management on the relationship between corporate governance and the efficiency of pension schemes in Kenya. The study employs panel data consisting of 896 observations from 128 schemes in a sample period from 2015 to 2021. The study finds that risk management significantly mediates the relationship between employee representatives on the board of trustees, as a component of corporate governance, and the efficiency of pension schemes. Consequently, the mediation effect of risk management indicates that when employee representatives are involved in governance, the presence of strong risk management practices ensures that their contributions lead to improved efficiency. Risk management, therefore, serves as a critical safeguard that enables governance structures to function more effectively and contribute to the overall performance of the scheme.

detail.abstract: As life expectancy in Kenya increases, so does the need for efficient pension schemes that can secure a dignified retirement and protect members from oldage poverty. Limited research, however, has explored the efficiency of these schemes under existing governance structures. This study addresses that gap by examining the combined effects of corporate governance, risk management, and industry regulation on pension scheme efficiency in Kenya. Using a quantitative design, we conducted a panel regression analysis on a seven-year secondary dataset of 128 Kenyan pension schemes, totalling 896 observations. Our results reveal significant insights: the presence of employee representatives on the board and effective risk management have a significant positive effect on efficiency. Conversely, independent board members exhibit a significant negative effect. Other factors, including top management representation, female board members, and industry regulation, showed no significant effect on efficiency in the joint model. These findings suggest that the impact of governance and risk management on efficiency is nuanced, with specific factors-like employee representation-playing a more prominent role. We propose that the electoral process for employee board members may introduce a "self-cleaning mechanism" that progressively enhances scheme efficiency. This mechanism offers a novel theoretical extension of Agency Theory, explaining the convergence of interests between elected trustees and scheme members.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了公司治理、风险管理和行业监管对肯尼亚养老金计划效率的联合影响。研究发现：员工代表和有效风险管理对效率有显著正向影响，而独立董事则有显著负向影响。其他因素如高管代表、女性董事和行业监管在联合模型中无显著影响。

detail.abstract: This study investigates the influence of supportive organizational climate and transformational leadership on job satisfaction and innovative work behavior among lecturers in vocational higher education institutions in East Java, Indonesia. A quantitative survey involving 105 lecturers was conducted, and the data were analyzed using structural equation modeling. The findings reveal that both supportive organizational climate and transformational leadership significantly and positively affect job satisfaction and innovative work behavior. Moreover, job satisfaction plays a mediating role, suggesting that a positive work environment and effective leadership enhance lecturer satisfaction, which in turn fosters innovation. These results highlight the strategic importance of building a supportive organizational culture and developing transformational leadership capacity to strengthen innovation and institutional sustainability in higher education. The study also contributes theoretically by validating the Stimulus Organism Response framework in the context of vocational education.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces an original analytical framework D = (M + A) × Cʷ developed by Ertiza Abbas in 2024-2025 to explain long-term strategic outcomes. Dominance (D) is expressed as the product of Mass and Alliances (M + A) multiplied by Cooperation (C) raised to the power of Worldview (W). Eleven major conflicts from 1950-2025 (Korean War through Ukraine and hypothetical Taiwan scenarios) are examined. In every case where conventional material metrics predicted rapid victory, collapse or stalemate occurred precisely when the ostensibly stronger power suffered degradation of internal cohesion (C) and collapse of justifying narrative (W). The exponent proves decisive. The framework offers predictive power superior to traditional realist variables and explains why high-W, high-C actors routinely neutralize 10-50× material disadvantages. The formula is offered as a permanent contribution to strategic studies. Formula for Strategic Dominance: D = (M + A) × C^W, an original framework conceived in 2024-2025. Eleven major conflicts (1950-2025) and one near-future scenario are tested. In every case, collapse or stalemate of the materially superior side occurred exactly when internal cohesion (C) and justifying worldview (W) decayed-rendering even 50:1 advantages irrelevant. The exponent proves decisive. The formula consistently outperforms traditional materialist metrics and is offered as a permanent, predictive contribution to strategic studies. This Research paper is a part of Ertiza Abbas's book "The Establishment".

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个原创的战略优势分析框架D = (M + A) × C^W，通过分析1950-2025年的11场主要冲突，证明内部凝聚力(C)和世界观(W)比传统物质因素更能预测战略结果。
AI.research_question: 如何解释和预测长期战略结果，特别是为什么物质优势方在某些冲突中会失败或陷入僵局？

AI.theoretical_framework: 战略优势公式D = (M + A) × C^W，其中D代表优势，M是质量，A是联盟，C是合作/内部凝聚力，W是世界观指数。
AI.method: 案例分析11场主要冲突（1950-2025年），包括朝鲜战争、乌克兰冲突和假设的台湾情景。
AI.findings: 在所有案例中，当物质优势方的内部凝聚力(C)和世界观(W)衰减时，即使拥有50:1的物质优势也会失败或陷入僵局。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个包含非物质因素的战略优势分析框架，挑战了传统现实主义理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 该框架具有优于传统指标的预测能力，可帮助决策者更好地评估战略态势。

detail.abstract: This paper is exploring De-employability both as a concept and process using sociological theory of AGIL modelling. With South Africa celebrating more than 30 years of democracy, a lot has been achieved especially in terms of affirmative action particularly racial and gender disparities redressing, even though this view is contested. Women empowerment through social policy is one of the trademarks that make South Africa different from her continental counterparts, over the past 03 decades we have seen female representation in fields that were previously male dominated. Mining, engineering; and general to executive management is evident in this regard. These achievements can be attributed to the conflict school of thought through the feminist frameworks. During apartheid in South Africa, Black South African males were disadvantaged, like other disadvantaged groups and were hoping for improved living conditions. Affirmative action aimed to address past inequalities, but the introduction and implementation of gender-based social policies among Black South Africans are causing a crisis that will require attention in the coming decades. For example, the Employment Equity Act applies to all types of employment, including internships and entry-level jobs, where black male students directly from university are at high risk of unemployment because of policies that prioritise black women over black men. This paper employs a qualitative research systematic review using the analytical realism paradigm. The paper discusses the structural de-employability of Black South African male graduates, arguing that deemployability is a concept rooted in understanding causal mechanisms. The argument is that theoretical models, like Parson's sociological theory, should reflect true causal structures related to the unemployment of these graduates, rather than just simplifying phenomena through models with unrealistic assumptions. This paper integrates analytical realism with grounded theory to offer a precise and abstract sociological concept of de-employability, critiquing instrumentalist approaches for their lack of realism. It contrasts with other scholars who use grounded theory purely as a paradigm, whereas this paper uses it as a research design to produce the new idea of deemployability based on Parson's AGIL model. The academic literature has not yet paid attention to the negative impact of this social policy on the employability of black South African men, despite their qualifications. Findings suggest that the latent function of the gender skewed social policy has failed to deliver the democratic gains for black South African males, the anomie of the same person remains unaccounted for. This study therefore recognises the systematic exclusion of Black South African Males from employment opportunities as De-employability and should be addresses using AGIL sociological model.

detail.title: "The Two Islams" Publication Series: Operationalizing the Distinction: A Policy Framework for Differentiating between Traditional Islam and Political Islamism
detail.abstract: This policy brief addresses a critical failure in contemporary security and immigration policy: the persistent conflation of the religion of Islam with the political ideology of Islamism. This analytical error alienates the vast majority of peaceful Muslims—who are the primary victims of Islamist extremism—and undermines the effectiveness of counter-terrorism efforts. To rectify this, the brief provides a clear, actionable diagnostic toolkit that differentiates Traditional Islam (a personal faith compatible with pluralism and the nation-state) from Political Islamism (a totalitarian ideology seeking to establish a global caliphate). Key differentiators include the primary source of religious authority, the goal of political engagement, and attitudes toward other faiths and local cultures. The brief concludes with concrete policy recommendations for immigration screening, counter-terrorism resource allocation, and community engagement. The central argument is that by precisely targeting the ideology and not the faith, states can split the enemy, build stronger alliances with traditional Muslim communities, and more effectively defend pluralistic societies against a totalitarian threat.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how digital market incentives shape the emotional tone of news headlines and the transmission of information. An analysis of more than 330,000 newspaper articles demonstrates that online headlines are markedly more emotional and negative than their print counterparts. Experiments with professional journalists show that stronger economic incentives to attract attention causally induce more emotional and negative headline choices. Complementary reader experiments indicate that such attention-driven environments increase engagement, but reduce factual learning. The findings document a market-based mechanism of media bias through which attention incentives amplify emotional framing in headlines and, in turn, impair audience learning.

title: Stakeholder Support and the Effectiveness of Carbon Disclosure Mandate
affiliations: Peking University - Guanghua School of Management, University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management and

detail.title: Stakeholder Support and the Effectiveness of Carbon Disclosure Mandate
detail.abstract: We show that stakeholder support plays a critical role in enabling disclosure mandates to achieve effective carbon reduction. Specifically, we examine a 2021 Chinese disclosure mandate intended to incentivize corporate carbon reduction and show that it produces different effects depending on the level of stakeholder support. We define treatment firms as those that undertook emission-reduction efforts in response to the mandate, and control firms as those that did not. We then categorize firms based on the level of institutional support in their headquarter regions, including the availability of carbon management professionals, green financing from local central bank branches, and environmental spending by local governments. We find that only treatment firms in regions with strong stakeholder support significantly reduce carbon intensity and emissions relative to matched control firms. These findings suggest that disclosure regulations alone cannot drive substantive emission reductions, and effective corporate decarbonization requires coordinated support from multiple external stakeholders.

detail.title: Beyond the Brussels Effect: The Surprising Rise of the International Sustainability Standards Board

detail.abstract: As climate-related risks become increasingly material to corporate performance and investor decision-making, the need for consistent, comparable disclosure standards has become urgent. Yet efforts to establish a global baseline have been hindered by regulatory fragmentation and competing frameworks. While the European Union's Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) was expected to trigger a "Brussels Effect" and define the global norm, its scope has since been scaled back in response to political and economic pressures. The United States had similarly retreated from comprehensive disclosure mandates. Against this backdrop, the International Sustainability Standards Board (ISSB) has emerged, somewhat unexpectedly, as the leading platform for global convergence. Created under the authority of the International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) Foundation, the body responsible for developing globally recognized accounting standards, the ISSB leveraged its institutional credibility and infrastructure to accelerate uptake. This paper argues that the ISSB's success stems not from regulatory power, but from its institutional design and grounding in private-sector practice. Notably, it builds directly on the Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB), a fully market-driven initiative created by and for private actors to produce financially material, decision-useful disclosures. By integrating SASB and Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD)'s risk framework, the ISSB offers a model that is both credible and pragmatic, one already familiar to global capital markets. This paper shows how the ISSB has transformed private standardsetting into a viable global baseline for climate disclosure.

detail.title: Leaving Home for University or Commuting? The Impact of Relocation Scholarships on Academic Progression

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Milan Bicocca Department of Economics, Management and Statistics Working Paper No. 563
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Milan Bicocca Department of Economics, Management & Statistics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study examines the causal impact of additional financial aid granted to students living far from university on their academic performance. It exploits an Italian policy that supports the relocation of scholarship recipients to the university city. Using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design based on a travel-time eligibility threshold, we compare the academic outcomes of scholarship holders enrolled at a medium-sized public university. Results indicate that relocated students accumulate credits more slowly and achieve lower average grades than comparable commuters, with no evidence that relocated students trade exam quality for quantity. A mediation analysis suggests that these effects may be driven by time-management difficulties and the limited adequacy of the financial support to cover living expenses. By focusing on an overlooked dimension of student aid, the paper contributes to the understanding of how financial support mechanisms interact with students' living arrangements and provides novel causal evidence on the interplay between financial aid and students' living arrangements in higher education.

title: Does Digitalization Lead to Climate Awareness? A Cross-Country Panel Data Analysis
affiliations: Islamic University, Bangladesh University of Professionals (BUP), Linkoping University - Department of Management and Engineering Division, Linkoping University - Department of Management and Engineering Division, Asian Development Bank - Economic Research and Asian Development Bank

detail.title: Does Digitalization Lead to Climate Awareness? A Cross-Country Panel Data Analysis

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 821

detail.abstract: Climate change, currently one of the most pressing challenges, requires increased public awareness and decisive action to support effective mitigation efforts. Comprehending digitalization’s potential role in shaping public understanding of climate-related issues has become a progressively important area of study. Against this backdrop, we undertake a pioneering attempt to examine how digitalization influences climate change awareness across diverse countries. To capture the multifaceted nature of digitalization, we construct a digitalization index, applying principal component analysis. Leveraging an annual panel dataset encompassing 65 countries over 2005–2020, our study applies several econometric techniques: panel-corrected standard errors, feasible generalized least squares, two-step system generalized method of moments, and panel quantile regression, to investigate this nexus. Our findings unveil a nonlinear U-shaped relationship between digitalization and climate awareness, suggesting that digitalization initially has a negligible or adverse impact but substantially boosts climate awareness after a digital maturity threshold is achieved. Furthermore, the share of renewable energy consumption also follows a U-shaped nonlinear pattern, while household consumption and corruption control contribute to boosting climate awareness. Conversely, the impact of human development, gross fixed capital, and trade openness becomes negligible when endogeneity is controlled. Our quantile-based analysis further validates these conclusions, although some factors vary across quantiles. These findings carry important policy implications, particularly emphasizing targeted fiscal policies to strengthen digital infrastructure and climate communication efforts, thereby facilitating tailored strategies for improved public climate awareness to meet climate sustainability.

title: Rethinking GPR: the sources of geopolitical risk
affiliations: Banco de España, Banco de España - Research Department and Banco de España

detail.title: Rethinking GPR: the sources of geopolitical risk

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banco de Espana Working Paper No. 2522
publicationDetails.journalName: Banco de Espana Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Geopolitical risks and tensions are nowadays regularly presented by policymakers and analysts as key conditioning factors of economic activity in both the short and the medium-run. Widely accepted operational measures of geopolitical risks tend to be based on counting the number of newspaper articles related to adverse geopolitical events, in particular following the ground-breaking paper of Caldara and Iacoviello (2022) in which they build their Geopolitical Risk (GPR) indexes. In this paper we propose one avenue to make further progress in the measurement of such risks. We provide a decomposition of GPR by exploiting the idea that the geopolitical risks that a country faces can be traced back to the countries or entities that are the source of those risks. In this regard, we exploit the idea that geopolitical risk linked to a specific geography or political entity can be interpreted as a “bilateral GPR”, and that the aggregation of such bilateral GPRs provides a natural way of interpreting the overall GPR index. We show that our indexes add distinct information from the benchmark GPR, and together form a more accurate representation of the geopolitical tensions currently present between the major economies. We also show that the geographical origin of a given GPR shock determines its macroeconomic effect in a given economy (as computed from standard VAR models), both in terms of the intensity of such effect and even its sign (i.e. whether a particular GPR shock causes GDP to increase or decrease).

detail.abstract: This working paper argues that the central ideological conflict of our time is not between "the West and Islam," but between pluralistic civilization and the totalitarian project of Political Islamism. Through a comparative analysis of case studies-including the genocidal campaigns against the Yezidi and Druze peoples, the cultural erasure of the Baluch, and the ideological subversion of Indonesia's Islam Nusantara-this paper traces how Political Islamism weaponizes theology and Arab cultural supremacy to systematically dismantle religious and cultural diversity. It further posits that the international focus on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict functions as a strategic diversion, providing moral camouflage for this broader campaign of ideological purification. The paper concludes with a call for a fundamental reorientation of moral and political resources toward the defense of the world's most vulnerable and ancient communities.

title: From Biodiversity Conservation to Stock Price Stability: International Evidence of Biodiversity Impact Reduction in Mitigating Stock Price Crash Risk
affiliations: Bentley University, Discipline of Accounting and Finance, Newcastle Business School, The University of Newcastle, Australia, Monash University - Monash University Malaysia, Xavier University and University of Southern Queensland

detail.title: From Biodiversity Conservation to Stock Price Stability: International Evidence of Biodiversity Impact Reduction in Mitigating Stock Price Crash Risk
detail.abstract: We examine whether biodiversity conservation reduces future stock price crash risk. Using global data from 41 countries between 2005 and 2022, we demonstrate that firms that take concrete actions to mitigate biodiversity impacts face significantly lower future crash risk. The effect is amplified by strong governance, climate-linked CEO pay, stakeholder-oriented legal regimes, and high national pollution pressure, but attenuated for firms that are opaque, financially constrained, or carbon-intensive. Firm fixed-effects, first-difference models, entropy balancing, and a difference-in-differences design centred on natural-disaster shocks address endogeneity. Mediation tests show that a higher ESG standing and fewer negative environmental news events partially transmit the benefit. By introducing biodiversity as a priced environmental risk, our paper expands the ESG-finance interface and offers new insights into the relationship between ecological stewardship and asset price stability.

affiliations: University of Minnesota School of Law - Center for New Americans, University of Minnesota - Twin Cities and University of Minnesota Twin Cities

detail.title: Executive Clemency and Immigration Federalism: Reconsidering Presidential Power Over Deportation Orders

publicationDetails.detailsText: Minnesota Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2025-51
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Minnesota Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Given the lack of clear historical precedent and the unique nature of deportation’s function in the criminal justice system, this article advocates for a constitutional basis for the President’s authority to grant clemency for deportation orders imposed on lawful permanent residents, refugees, or other noncitizens stripped of their legal immigration status as a result of mandated deportation after a criminal conviction. 

We contend  that violations of the immigration statute that mandate deportation based on criminal convictions are punitive in nature and thus while civil, are nonetheless a penalty; second, we contend that given this punitive nature, violations of such laws qualify as "offenses against the United States" and, therefore, are eligible for clemency under the President's pardon power. Because deportation as a process is completely and exclusively federal, it does not matter whether the underlying crimes that resulted in the deportation orders are state or federal. Deportation is a federal penalty which places it within the ambit of the President’s constitutional power to grant a reprieve under the pardon clause.

AI.method: 法律分析和理论论证。
AI.findings: 基于刑事定罪的驱逐具有惩罚性质，属于"违反美国法律"的罪行，因此符合总统宽恕权力的适用范围。
AI.theory_contributions: 确立了驱逐的惩罚性质理论，扩展了宽恕条款的适用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为被驱逐的非公民提供了寻求总统宽恕的法律依据，增强了司法救济途径。

title: The Impact of Firm Complexity on Financial Leverage
affiliations: Penn State Harrisburg, Old Dominion University - Strome College of Business and Youngstown State University

detail.title: The Impact of Firm Complexity on Financial Leverage
detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of firm complexity on corporate leverage decisions. We find that more complex firms maintain significantly higher market and book leverage.  These results remain robust across alternative specifications and after addressing endogeneity concerns through instrumental variable and propensity score matching approaches. Further analyses reveal that agency costs represent a key mechanism, as institutional monitoring substitutes for debt discipline, whereas excess free cash flow amplifies leverage. Moreover, managerial ability mitigates the positive relation between complexity and leverage, indicating that capable managers rely less on debt as a governance tool. Finally, while both complexity and leverage individually reduce firm value, their interaction alleviates this effect, suggesting that debt is used strategically in complex firms to enhance efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨企业复杂度对公司杠杆决策的影响，发现更复杂的企业维持显著更高的市场杠杆和账面杠杆。代理成本是重要机制，机构监督可替代债务约束，而超额自由现金流会放大杠杆效应。管理能力能缓解复杂度与杠杆的正相关关系，表明有能力的管理者较少依赖债务作为治理工具。虽然复杂度和杠杆各自降低企业价值，但它们的交互作用能缓解这种负面影响，表明复杂企业会战略性地使用债务来提高效率。
AI.research_question: 企业复杂度如何影响公司杠杆决策？
AI.motivation: 理解企业复杂度在资本结构决策中的作用机制，特别是代理成本和管理能力在其中的调节作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理成本理论、资本结构理论和公司治理理论，探讨复杂度如何通过代理机制影响杠杆决策。
AI.method: 采用工具变量法和倾向得分匹配法解决内生性问题，使用多种稳健性检验验证结果。
AI.findings: 1) 更复杂的企业维持更高杠杆；2) 代理成本是重要机制；3) 机构监督可替代债务约束；4) 管理能力缓解复杂度与杠杆的正相关；5) 复杂度与杠杆的交互作用能缓解对企业价值的负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了复杂度在资本结构决策中的理论理解，揭示了代理成本和管理能力在其中的调节机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂企业的资本结构决策提供实践指导，强调管理能力和机构监督在优化杠杆使用中的重要性。

title: Do Firms Pollute More after Going Public? Evidence from Hydraulic Fracturing Operators
affiliations: Monash University, HKU Business School, The University of Hong Kong and Monash University

detail.title: Do Firms Pollute More after Going Public? Evidence from Hydraulic Fracturing Operators
detail.abstract: We examine changes in firms’ environmental externality and pollution intensity after going public, using detailed project-level data of hydraulic fracturing (HF) operators. Employing a difference-in-differences design, we find that after their initial public offerings (IPO), the operators use more toxic chemicals per well, compared with non-IPO operators that drill wells in the same period and the same area. Further analysis suggests that the increase in pollution intensity is related to firms’ incentives to maximize short-term profits and the enhanced risk sharing with new shareholders after IPOs. Finally, we find that after the operators go public the concentration of the toxic chemicals increases in surface water near the wells. Our results suggest that going public may exacerbate firms’ negative environmental externality.

AI.tldr: 研究发现企业上市后增加了环境负外部性，通过页岩气开采项目数据发现IPO后的企业每口井使用更多有毒化学品，且地表水中有毒化学物质浓度升高。
AI.research_question: 企业上市是否会影响其环境外部性和污染强度？
AI.motivation: 考察企业上市后环境行为的变化，特别是对污染强度的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业短期利润最大化动机和与新股东风险分担的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用双重差分设计，比较IPO与非IPO企业在同一时期和地区的页岩气开采项目数据。
AI.findings: IPO后的企业每口井使用更多有毒化学品，地表水中有毒化学物质浓度升高。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了企业上市与环境外部性之间的关系机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和投资者评估企业上市的环境影响提供实证依据。

title: Assessing Long-term Climate Trends in Central Bangladesh: A Case Study of Tangail District
affiliations: Mawlana Bhashani Science and Technology University and Mawlana Bhashani Science and Technology University

detail.title: Assessing Long-term Climate Trends in Central Bangladesh: A Case Study of Tangail District
detail.abstract: In this study, we have analyzed three decades of meteorological data (1993–2023) for Tangail, Bangladesh, in order to detect patterns of temperature, precipitation, humidity and wind speed and extrapolate them through 2028, from which they can be applied towards the development of new building infrastructure. Trends suggest significant rise in maximum and minimum temperatures for both the pre monsoon as well as monsoon seasons and an increase by 1.5°C (maximum) and 1°C (minimum), higher relative humidity has decreased by 4%–6%, declining rainfall annual trend with a marginal increase in December. Wind has descended as well, from 3.5 to going around at just 1.5 knots. These changes and their interactions with broader climate change effects, such as urbanization, deforestation, changes in atmospheric circulation patterns etc., have serious consequences for agriculture, water resources, infrastructure and public health in Tangail. Increasing heat increases heat stress in crops, compromises food supplies and leads to water shortages; decreasing humidity adds another level of stress on agriculture and structures from less moisture in the soil or drier air. It emphasizes the need for adaptive mechanisms to reduce such impacts, such as investment in drought-resistant varieties or climate-resilient infrastructure. The study also stresses on water management. Furthermore, strong public health measures and better climate systems are needed to make the region more resilient to such (bio)hazards. The findings illustrate the importance of acting now to cope with climate change in the region and ensure sustainability in the longer term.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了孟加拉国坦盖尔地区1993-2023年的气象数据，发现温度显著上升、湿度下降、降雨减少和风速减弱等气候变化趋势，并预测这些趋势将持续到2028年，对农业、水资源、基础设施和公共健康产生严重影响。
AI.research_question: 坦盖尔地区过去30年的气候变化模式是什么？这些变化对未来建筑基础设施发展有何影响？
AI.motivation: 了解坦盖尔地区的气候变化趋势，为制定适应性策略和建设气候韧性基础设施提供科学依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于长期气象数据分析的气候变化理论，结合城市化、森林砍伐和大气环流模式变化等影响因素。
AI.method: 分析1993-2023年30年的气象数据，包括温度、降水、湿度和风速等参数，并进行趋势外推至2028年。
AI.findings: 最高和最低温度显著上升（分别升高1.5°C和1°C），相对湿度下降4%-6%，年降雨量呈下降趋势，风速从3.5节降至1.5节。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了坦盖尔地区详细的气候变化实证数据，揭示了该地区特有的气候变化模式及其与全球气候变化的关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定适应性农业策略、水资源管理、气候韧性基础设施建设和公共卫生措施提供了具体指导，强调立即采取行动应对气候变化的重要性。

title: The Impact of Tourism on Economic Growth of Cape Verde and Its Disparties
affiliations: University of Tunis and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Impact of Tourism on Economic Growth of Cape Verde and Its Disparties
detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of tourism on the economic growth of Cape Verde, with particular attention to the regional and social disparities that accompany its expansion. Employing a mixed-methods approach that integrates econometric analysis with qualitative inquiry, the research investigates both the macroeconomic significance of tourism and its distributional outcomes across the archipelago. Quantitative findings confirm the validity of the tourism-led growth hypothesis (TLGH) in Cape Verde, revealing a strong and positive correlation between tourism receipts, international arrivals, and GDP growth. However, the qualitative evidence highlights uneven spatial development, with economic activity concentrated on the islands of Sal and Boa Vista, while peripheral islands remain largely excluded from the benefits of tourismdriven growth. The study further identifies structural inequalities in employment, income, and gender representation, as well as environmental and governance challenges linked to rapid resort expansion. Collectively, these findings underscore tourism's dual role as a driver of modernization and a source of inequality. The study concludes that for tourism to serve as a sustainable and inclusive development strategy, Cape Verde must strengthen local linkages, diversify its tourism model, and enhance equitable policy frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本研究证实了佛得角存在旅游驱动经济增长假说，但旅游业发展导致了区域和社会不平等，需要加强本地联系、多元化旅游模式和公平政策框架来实现可持续发展。
AI.research_question: 旅游业对佛得角经济增长的影响是什么？伴随旅游业扩张的区域和社会不平等有哪些？
AI.motivation: 探讨旅游业在佛得角经济发展中的双重作用——既推动现代化又产生不平等，为制定可持续和包容性发展策略提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 旅游驱动经济增长假说(TLGH)、区域发展理论、不平等理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：结合计量经济学分析和定性调查
AI.findings: 1) 旅游收入、国际游客数量与GDP增长呈强正相关；2) 经济活动集中在萨尔岛和博阿维斯塔岛，外围岛屿被排除在旅游收益之外；3) 就业、收入和性别代表性存在结构性不平等；4) 快速度假村扩张带来环境和治理挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了TLGH在佛得角的适用性，揭示了旅游业发展的双重性——经济增长与不平等并存
AI.practical_contributions: 为佛得角政府提供了促进旅游业可持续发展的政策建议：加强本地联系、多元化旅游模式、建立公平政策框架

title: The effects of leveraged buyouts on industry peers’ capital structure
affiliations: University of Augsburg

detail.title: The effects of leveraged buyouts on industry peers’ capital structure
detail.abstract: This study examines how leveraged buyouts (LBOs) affect the capital structure of target firms’ industry peers.Using a sample of US public firms, I find that peer firms significantly increase their leverage ratios following LBO announcements in their industry.The effect is more pronounced in competitive industries, consistent with LBOs generating positive competitive spillovers.Managers of peer firms also use higher leverage ratios as a defense tool against potential follow-on acquisitions, independent of existing anti-takover provisions.There is no evidence that peers increase leverage to address industry-wide agency problems signaled by LBOs.Further analyses show that the results are not driven by changes in debt supply.Overall, the findings indicate that LBOs convey valuable information for managers of industry peers regarding capital structure decisions.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现杠杆收购(LBOs)对目标公司行业同行的资本结构产生显著影响，同行公司在LBO公告后会显著提高杠杆率，特别是在竞争性行业中。管理层将提高杠杆率作为防御后续收购的工具。
AI.research_question: 杠杆收购如何影响目标公司行业同行的资本结构决策？
AI.motivation: 理解LBOs对行业内其他公司的溢出效应，特别是资本结构决策方面的信息传递机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争溢出效应理论、防御性资本结构理论、信息传递理论
AI.method: 使用美国上市公司样本，分析LBO公告后同行公司杠杆率的变化，控制行业竞争程度等因素
AI.findings: 同行公司在LBO公告后显著提高杠杆率；在竞争性行业中效应更明显；管理层将高杠杆作为防御工具；结果不受债务供给变化驱动
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了LBOs溢出效应的理论框架，提出了防御性资本结构的新视角，丰富了信息传递理论在资本结构决策中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为行业管理者提供LBOs作为资本结构决策参考信息的实践指导，帮助公司制定防御性财务策略

title: Probability of Default, Leverage, and Dynamics: A Novel Approach1
affiliations: University of Konstanz - Department of Economics, Deutsche Bundesbank and University of Groningen

detail.title: Probability of Default, Leverage, and Dynamics: A Novel Approach1
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes probabilities of default (PD) and book leverage of German firms. A novelty of our paper is to model PDs as an AR process of PD changes and an initial PD. Regressions show mean diversion of the PDs in the short run and mean reversion to long-term target PDs over longer time intervals. The PD does not converge monotonically to the target PD. We obtain similar dynamics for book leverage. PD changes and leverage changes are largely uncorrelated. The target PD is lower when more than one bank reports a PD, also if a firm owner bears unlimited liability. We also rank firms within an industry according to their PDs. For migrations, i.e., changes in this rank order, we also find mean diversion in the short run and mean reversion over longer time intervals. The adjustment speed appears to be higher for PD ranks than for PDs.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了德国企业的违约概率和账面杠杆率，创新性地将违约概率建模为PD变化的自回归过程和初始PD。研究发现PD在短期内呈现均值偏离，在长期内呈现均值回归至目标PD的动态特征，且调整过程并非单调收敛。杠杆率变化与PD变化基本不相关。
AI.research_question: 德国企业的违约概率和账面杠杆率具有怎样的动态特征？这些动态特征如何受到企业特征和银行报告行为的影响？
AI.motivation: 理解企业违约概率的动态行为对于风险管理和信用评估具有重要意义，现有研究对PD的动态调整过程关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于均值回归理论和自回归过程建模，考虑企业违约概率的动态调整机制。
AI.method: 使用德国企业数据，建立PD变化的AR过程模型，进行回归分析检验均值偏离和均值回归现象。
AI.findings: PD在短期内呈现均值偏离，长期内呈现均值回归至目标PD；PD与杠杆率变化基本不相关；多银行报告和无限责任会降低目标PD；PD排名的调整速度比PD本身更快。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了PD动态调整的非单调收敛特征，扩展了信用风险动态建模的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行信用风险评估和风险管理提供了更准确的PD动态预测模型，有助于改进信用评级方法。

title: Risk-Return Analysis of Mutual Funds
affiliations: and Universidad Europea de Madrid

detail.title: Risk-Return Analysis of Mutual Funds
detail.abstract: Portfolio performance evaluation is a very important part of investment management analysis and is generally carried out by evaluating risk-adjusted returns. This paper analyzes the performance of equity mutual funds across 35 countries that use the national stock index as a financial benchmark from 1990 to 2024, employing reference indicators such as alpha, adjusted alpha, and the Sharpe, Sortino, and Treynor indices. Methodologically, three analyses are performed: correlation (between mutual fund and index returns), efficiency (differential return of the mutual fund relative to the index), and persistence (sustainability of returns). According to the findings, the analyzed mutual funds across countries have obtained a return commensurate with the risk and have been a good vehicle for emulating it, both for replicating the indices and for use in hedging operations with financial derivatives. The article constitutes a novel study, given the recent enlargement of many stock indices and the context of volatility over the years examined.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了1990-2024年间35个国家以国家股票指数为基准的股票型共同基金表现，使用alpha、夏普比率等指标评估风险调整后收益。研究发现这些基金获得了与风险相称的回报，是复制指数和对冲操作的良好工具。
AI.research_question: 以国家股票指数为基准的股票型共同基金在风险调整后收益方面的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 投资组合绩效评估是投资管理分析的重要组成部分，通常通过评估风险调整后收益来进行。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资组合绩效评估理论，包括风险调整后收益衡量指标（alpha、调整alpha、夏普指数、索提诺指数、特雷诺指数）
AI.method: 对35个国家1990-2024年间的股票型共同基金进行三种分析：相关性分析（基金与指数收益）、效率分析（基金相对于指数的差异收益）、持续性分析（收益的可持续性）
AI.findings: 分析的各国共同基金获得了与风险相称的回报，是复制指数和对冲操作的良好工具
AI.theory_contributions: 在股票指数扩大和多年波动背景下提供了新颖的研究，扩展了国际共同基金绩效评估的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了关于股票型共同基金作为指数复制和对冲工具有效性的实证支持

title: Investigate the Accelerated Life Tests in Reliability theory via Statistical Inference View
affiliations: Cairo University, Al-Azhar University and Cairo University

detail.title: Investigate the Accelerated Life Tests in Reliability theory via Statistical Inference View
detail.abstract: Accelerated testing is still an important way to predict how well a product will work, but it needs to be done in a way that takes into account many di⁄erent factors. Manufacturers can close the gap and make sure their products last in real life by using real-world data, improving test protocols, and constantly checking results. This paper seeks to support manufacturers in improving their predictive accuracy concerning material longevity by utilizing advanced testing tools, all within the structure of statistical inference. By constant-stress accelerated life testing using type-II censoring of failure data from a new odd lindley half-logistic distribution (OLiHL distribution), the maximum likelihood estimates (MLEs) and Bayes estimates (BEs) of the model parameters are obtained. In addition, the approximate, bootstrap and credible con dence intervals (CIs) of the estimators are constructed. Finally, simulation studies are carried out to investigate the accuracy of the MLEs and BEs for the parameters involved.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于新型OLiHL分布的加速寿命测试方法，通过最大似然估计和贝叶斯估计来预测材料寿命，并构建了多种置信区间来提高预测准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用新型OLiHL分布和统计推断方法提高加速寿命测试中材料寿命预测的准确性？
AI.motivation: 加速测试是预测产品性能的重要方法，但需要考虑多种因素。制造商需要通过实际数据、改进测试协议和持续验证结果来确保产品在实际使用中的寿命。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于新型奇Lindley半逻辑分布（OLiHL分布）的统计推断理论，包括最大似然估计、贝叶斯估计和置信区间构建方法。
AI.method: 采用恒定应力加速寿命测试，使用II型截尾失效数据，通过最大似然估计和贝叶斯估计获取模型参数，并构建近似、自助法和可信置信区间。
AI.findings: 通过模拟研究验证了最大似然估计和贝叶斯估计在参数估计中的准确性，为材料寿命预测提供了可靠的统计工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于OLiHL分布的新型统计建模方法，扩展了加速寿命测试的理论框架，丰富了可靠性工程中的统计推断工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制造商提供了改进产品寿命预测准确性的实用方法，有助于优化测试协议和提高产品质量控制水平。

title: Forecasting Nigeria’s Inflation Components Using Machine Learning and Econometric Models: A Comparative Analysis
affiliations: University of Ibadan and University of Ibadan

detail.title: Forecasting Nigeria’s Inflation Components Using Machine Learning and Econometric Models: A Comparative Analysis
detail.abstract: This study models and forecasts monthly headline, food, and core inflation in Nigeria using both traditional econometric and modern machine learning approaches. Specifically, the Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) and Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity (GARCH) models were compared with Random Forest (RF) and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) algorithms to evaluate their predictive accuracy and stability. Monthly inflation data obtained from the Central Bank of Nigeria and the National Bureau of Statistics were analyzed, covering food, core, and overall inflation components. The results reveal that while ARIMA and GARCH effectively capture linear and volatility dynamics, machine learning models particularly XGBoost exhibited superior predictive performance in out-of-sample forecasts. Among the inflation components, food inflation emerged as the dominant driver of overall price volatility, underscoring its structural and policy significance. The study concludes that integrating machine learning models into inflation forecasting frameworks enhances predictive precision and early-warning capacity for policy authorities. Consequently, policymakers are encouraged to strengthen data analytics infrastructure, stabilize food supply chains, and adopt data-driven monetary and fiscal interventions to mitigate inflationary pressures and support food security in Nigeria.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了传统计量经济学模型（ARIMA、GARCH）和机器学习方法（随机森林、XGBoost）在预测尼日利亚月度通胀率方面的表现，发现XGBoost在样本外预测中表现最优，特别是食品通胀是整体价格波动的主要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 传统计量经济学模型与机器学习方法在预测尼日利亚月度通胀率方面的预测准确性和稳定性如何比较？
AI.motivation: 提高尼日利亚通胀预测的准确性，为政策制定者提供更有效的早期预警能力，以应对通胀压力和支持粮食安全。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间序列分析理论（ARIMA、GARCH模型）和机器学习理论（随机森林、XGBoost算法）。
AI.method: 使用尼日利亚央行和国家统计局提供的月度通胀数据，比较ARIMA、GARCH与随机森林、XGBoost模型的预测性能。
AI.findings: 机器学习模型特别是XGBoost在样本外预测中表现优于传统模型；食品通胀是整体价格波动的主要驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了机器学习方法在通胀预测中的有效性，为时间序列预测理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的通胀预测工具，建议加强数据分析基础设施、稳定食品供应链，并采取数据驱动的政策干预措施。

title: Perception of Risk and User Cost in Property Markets: Evidence from Surfside Partial Building Collapse
affiliations: Florida International University, Florida International University (FIU), Florida International University (FIU) - College of Business Administration and Florida International University (FIU) - Hollo School of Real Estate

detail.title: Perception of Risk and User Cost in Property Markets: Evidence from Surfside Partial Building Collapse
detail.abstract: This study investigates how unexpected structural failures, such as the Champlain Towers South collapse, can profoundly alter real estate market dynamics. Based on data from the Multiple Listing Service (MLS) for Miami-Dade from 2020 through 2022, the findings show that older condos experienced significant post-collapse list price discounts, longer time on the market, and reduced sale prices compared to newer units. These effects were not observed in the single-family home market, indicating that the collapse amplified perceptions of risk and increased financial burdens, specifically for aging condos. The negative impacts were especially pronounced for taller buildings and those near the coast, where maintenance and insurance costs are higher. Overall, the study underscores the critical influence of catastrophic events on property markets and highlights the need for policymakers and industry stakeholders to adapt to evolving risks and regulatory challenges to maintain market stability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Champlain Towers South倒塌等意外结构故障如何深刻改变房地产市场动态。基于2020-2022年迈阿密-戴德县MLS数据，发现老旧公寓在倒塌后出现显著挂牌价折扣、上市时间延长和售价降低，而独栋住宅市场未受影响。影响在高层建筑和沿海建筑中尤为明显。
AI.research_question: 意外结构故障（如Champlain Towers South倒塌）如何影响房地产市场动态？
AI.motivation: 研究灾难性事件对房地产市场的关键影响，帮助政策制定者和行业利益相关者适应不断变化的风险和监管挑战以维持市场稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险感知理论、市场动态理论、房地产定价理论
AI.method: 基于2020-2022年迈阿密-戴德县多重上市服务系统（MLS）数据的实证分析
AI.findings: 老旧公寓在倒塌后出现显著挂牌价折扣、上市时间延长和售价降低；独栋住宅市场未受影响；高层建筑和沿海建筑受影响更严重
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对灾难性事件如何通过风险感知改变房地产市场动态的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和行业利益相关者提供应对结构风险和维持市场稳定的实践指导

title: Misinterpretating Immigration Law
affiliations: University of Nevada, Las Vegas, William S. Boyd School of Law

detail.title: Misinterpretating Immigration Law
detail.abstract: Although Congress bears primary responsibility for the convoluted nature of America's immigration laws, immigration law has been rendered even more incoherent through inconsistent interpretation. During the reign of Chevron deference, the federal courts, the Board of Immigration Appeals and various Attorneys General pushed in different directions, with textualist, libertarian, and restrictionist impulses holding sway on different major interpretive questions. The result is that immigration law is more internally incoherent and more divorced from popular opinion than is necessitated by the text of the Immigration and Nationality Act. The end of Chevron deference offers some potential for the federal courts to bring a more consistent interpretive approach to immigration law, but it is by no means certain that the courts will take this opportunity.

AI.tldr: 美国移民法因国会立法复杂且法院解释不一致而变得不连贯。Chevron尊重原则期间，不同机构采用文本主义、自由主义和限制主义等不同解释方法，导致移民法内部矛盾且脱离民意。Chevron原则的终结为联邦法院提供统一解释的机会，但效果不确定。
AI.research_question: 美国移民法的不连贯性是如何形成的？Chevron尊重原则的终结对移民法解释有何影响？
AI.motivation: 探讨移民法在立法和司法解释层面的不连贯问题，分析Chevron原则终结带来的潜在变革
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律解释理论、司法尊重原则、移民法理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析和司法判例研究
AI.findings: 移民法的不连贯性源于国会立法复杂性和法院解释不一致；Chevron原则期间不同机构采用矛盾解释方法；Chevron终结可能带来更一致的司法解释
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对法律解释不一致性成因的理解，探讨司法尊重原则对法律体系连贯性的影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为移民法改革提供理论依据，指导法院在Chevron原则终结后采取更一致的司法解释方法

title: The Impact of Fintech, Sustainability Banking, and Natural Resources on Environmental Sustainability
affiliations: , Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia - Indonesia University of Education, Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia - Indonesia University of Education, Faculty of Economics and Business Education, Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia, Indonesia and Kuningan University

detail.title: The Impact of Fintech, Sustainability Banking, and Natural Resources on Environmental Sustainability
detail.abstract: This study aims to analyze the role of FinTech, sustainable banking, and natural resource revenues collectively influencing environmental outcomes in the ASEAN Plus Three region is still scarce. This study uses panel data regression analysis covering nine ASEAN Plus Three countries over the period 2017 to 2021. The findings provide evidence of the significant influence of FinTech, Sustainable Banking, and natural resource revenues derived from sustainable environmental development activities in Plus Three economies. FinTech has a very negative effect on environmental outcomes. In contrast, sustainable banking does not show a statistically significant effect. Natural resource revenues are positively related to environmental degradation. These results highlight the importance of implementing low-carbon technologies to meet carbon neutrality targets in ASEAN Plus Three countries. The findings offer empirical insights for policymakers to prioritize green technologies, reassess fintech's environmental footprint, and strengthen the sustainable banking framework.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了金融科技、可持续银行和自然资源收入对东盟+三国环境结果的共同影响。研究发现金融科技对环境有显著负面影响，可持续银行影响不显著，自然资源收入与环境退化正相关。
AI.research_question: 金融科技、可持续银行和自然资源收入如何共同影响东盟+三国的环境结果？
AI.motivation: 目前关于金融科技、可持续银行和自然资源收入共同影响东盟+三国环境结果的研究仍然稀缺
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融科技、可持续银行和自然资源收入对环境影响的综合理论框架
AI.method: 面板数据回归分析，涵盖2017-2021年东盟+三国的9个国家
AI.findings: 金融科技对环境结果有显著负面影响；可持续银行没有统计显著影响；自然资源收入与环境退化正相关
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了金融科技、可持续银行和自然资源收入对环境影响的实证证据，填补了相关研究空白
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证见解，建议优先发展绿色技术、重新评估金融科技的环境足迹、加强可持续银行框架

title: Search Spillovers: The SEC's Role in Shaping Information Acquisition
affiliations: University of Colorado at Boulder and University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business

detail.title: Search Spillovers: The SEC's Role in Shaping Information Acquisition
detail.abstract: This study examines whether the SEC's user interface influences which firms' disclosures users acquire. We focus on EDGAR's company search function, which features a predictive dropdown menu that dynamically updates suggestions as users input their search queries. We find that when an S&P 500 firm experiences elevated information acquisition-measured by EDGAR clicksneighboring firms on the dropdown menu also experience a significant increase in information acquisition, compared to control firms in the same industry and of similar size. Consistent with position bias, this spillover effect is stronger for neighboring firms ranked higher on the menu. Finally, we provide suggestive evidence that spillover attention from EDGAR's dropdown menu influences retail investors' trading behavior. These findings highlight the importance of the SEC's user interface design, as seemingly minor design features can have consequences for information acquisition and investor behavior.

AI.tldr: SEC的EDGAR搜索界面下拉菜单设计会影响用户获取哪些公司披露信息，菜单中的位置偏差导致邻近公司获得信息获取溢出效应，进而影响零售投资者交易行为。
AI.research_question: SEC的用户界面是否影响用户获取哪些公司的披露信息？
AI.motivation: 研究SEC用户界面设计对信息获取和投资者行为的影响，因为看似微小的设计特征可能产生重要后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 位置偏差理论 - 搜索界面中排名靠前的选项更容易被用户选择。
AI.method: 利用EDGAR公司搜索功能中的预测下拉菜单，分析标普500公司信息获取增加时邻近公司的信息获取变化，与同行业同规模控制组比较。
AI.findings: 1) 标普500公司信息获取增加时，下拉菜单中邻近公司也显著增加信息获取；2) 位置偏差效应：排名越高的邻近公司溢出效应越强；3) 下拉菜单的溢出注意力影响零售投资者交易行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了用户界面设计在信息获取中的重要作用，扩展了位置偏差理论在金融信息披露环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构设计用户界面提供重要启示，强调看似微小的界面特征可能对市场信息效率和投资者行为产生系统性影响。

title: De crecimiento y decrecimiento: Apostilla al futuro sostenible (On Growth and Decrease: An Observation on the Sustainable Future)
affiliations: Universidad de Zaragoza

detail.title: De crecimiento y decrecimiento: Apostilla al futuro sostenible (On Growth and Decrease: An Observation on the Sustainable Future)
detail.abstract:
Spanish Abstract: Comentamos un pasaje del último capítulo del libro de E. O. Wilson Consilience: The Unity of Knowledgte, relativo a la sostenibilidad de las economías humanas, especialmente las globalizadas. El autor prevé un colapso medioambiental que difícilmente se podrá evitar, con las dinámicas adquiridas por la economía y la población en expansión continua, y que llevará a grandes catástrofes tanto humanas como medioambientales a menos que se reconozcan y establezcan objetivos comunes para la acción humana global. Expresamos nuestro pesimismo y escepticismo sobre la existencia siquiera y la posibilidad de objetivos y prioridades comunes en la humanidad, a nivel local y global.

 

English Abstract: This is a commentary of a passage from the last chapter of E. O. Wilson's book Consilience: The Unity of Knowledge, regarding the sustainability of human economic systems, and more specifically the global economy. Wilson foresees the difficulty of avoiding an environmental collapse, taking into account the acquired dynamics of a growing population and economy, and the possibility of great catastrophes at both a human and environmental level, unless global aims for human action are recognized and established. Here we voice our pessimism and skepticism regarding the mere existence and possibility of common aims and priorities in mankind, either at a local or global level.

AI.tldr: 本文评论了E.O. Wilson《知识的统一》一书中关于全球经济可持续性的观点，表达了对人类能否建立共同目标和优先事项的悲观态度。
AI.research_question: 人类是否能够建立共同的目标和优先事项来避免环境崩溃？
AI.motivation: 对Wilson关于全球经济可持续性观点的批判性反思，质疑人类在地方和全球层面达成共识的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Wilson的《知识的统一》理论框架，特别是关于知识统一性和环境可持续性的观点。
AI.method: 文献评论和批判性分析，对Wilson著作中特定段落进行评论。
AI.findings: 作者对Wilson提出的通过建立共同目标来避免环境崩溃的解决方案表示悲观和怀疑。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了Wilson关于人类能够达成共识的乐观假设，强调了人类利益分歧的现实。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者关注人类在环境问题上达成共识的困难，为环境治理提供更现实的视角。

title: Finance et comptabilité dans l’économie post-capitaliste.
affiliations: University of London

detail.title: Finance et comptabilité dans l’économie post-capitaliste.
detail.abstract:
French Abstract: Face aux limites croissantes du capitalisme : inégalités, dérives financières, destruction environnementale, cet article explore la nécessité d’un nouveau paradigme économique. En partant du triptyque économie-finance-comptabilité, il montre comment la financiarisation a dévoyé la finalité initiale de l’économie : le bien-être collectif. Il propose une pensée post-capitaliste fondée sur la soutenabilité, la démocratie économique et la redéfinition de la valeur. À travers une nouvelle fonction de la finance et une comptabilité intégrée prenant en compte le vivant, l’article esquisse les contours d’un système économique au service de la vie, et non de la seule accumulation. Une critique interne vient enfin interroger les défis de mise en œuvre de ce projet.

English Abstract: Faced with the growing limitations of capitalism—rising inequality, financial excesses, and environmental degradation—this article explores the need for a new economic paradigm. Using the economy-finance-accounting triptych as a lens, it shows how financialization has diverted the original purpose of economics: collective well-being. The paper proposes a post-capitalist framework based on sustainability, economic democracy, and a redefinition of value. Through a reimagined role of finance and an integrated accounting approach that includes the living world, the article outlines the contours of an economic system that serves life rather than mere accumulation. An internal critique also examines the practical challenges of implementing this vision.

AI.tldr: 本文批判资本主义的局限性，提出基于可持续性、经济民主和价值重定义的后资本主义经济范式，通过重新构想金融角色和整合会计方法来构建服务于生命而非资本积累的经济体系。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个超越资本主义局限、服务于集体福祉和可持续发展的新经济范式？
AI.motivation: 资本主义面临日益严重的不平等、金融过度和环境破坏等局限性，需要探索新的经济模式来恢复经济服务于集体福祉的初衷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济-金融-会计三位一体框架、后资本主义理论、可持续性理论、经济民主理论、价值重定义理论
AI.method: 理论分析和概念框架构建，通过批判现有资本主义体系的缺陷，提出替代性的经济范式设计
AI.findings: 金融化扭曲了经济的原始目的，需要重新定义金融角色和建立包含生命要素的整合会计体系，以构建服务于生命而非资本积累的经济系统
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于可持续性、经济民主和价值重定义的后资本主义经济理论框架，拓展了替代经济范式的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和社会变革者提供了构建新经济系统的具体思路，包括金融功能重构和会计体系改革

title: The Impact of the EU Emergency Trust Fund for Africa on Migration Aspirations
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF) and Kiel Institute for the World Economy

detail.title: The Impact of the EU Emergency Trust Fund for Africa on Migration Aspirations

declarations.funderStatement: This paper was produced as part of the \emph{DYNAMIG} project, funded by the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation program under grant agreement number 101094347.

detail.abstract: This paper evaluates whether the EU Emergency Trust Fund for Africa (EUTF) has reduced migration aspirations in African origin regions. Using sub-national data from the EUTF's Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning System (MLS) and individual-level data from the Gallup World Poll, we employ a difference-indifferences approach. Our findings indicate that sub-national regions where EUTF projects were implemented on average experienced substantial reductions in migration aspirations. We find similar effects by gender. Our investigations of potential mechanisms point to a particular relevance of improvements in satisfaction with the standard of living and the availability of basic services. Our paper thus adds to the debate on the effectiveness of development assistance in shaping migration decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了欧盟非洲紧急信托基金（EUTF）是否降低了非洲原籍地区的移民意愿。通过使用EUTF的监测评估学习系统和盖洛普世界民意调查数据，采用双重差分方法发现，实施EUTF项目的地区平均经历了移民意愿的显著下降。机制分析表明生活水平和基本服务满意度的改善是重要因素。
AI.research_question: 欧盟非洲紧急信托基金（EUTF）是否降低了非洲原籍地区的移民意愿？
AI.motivation: 评估发展援助在影响移民决策方面的有效性，为相关政策和辩论提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于发展援助与移民决策关系的理论框架，探讨经济改善如何影响人们的移民意愿。
AI.method: 使用EUTF的监测评估学习系统（MLS）的次国家级数据和盖洛普世界民意调查的个体层面数据，采用双重差分（difference-in-differences）方法。
AI.findings: 实施EUTF项目的次国家级区域平均经历了移民意愿的显著下降；性别分析显示类似效应；机制分析表明生活水平和基本服务满意度的改善是重要因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展援助影响移民决策的理论提供了实证支持，揭示了生活条件和基本服务满意度在移民决策中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及其他国际组织的移民和发展援助政策提供了实证依据，表明改善生活条件和基本服务可能是减少移民意愿的有效策略。

title: Neural Network-Driven Volatility Drag Mitigation under Aggressive Leverage
affiliations: CentraleSupélec, University of Catania and University of Palermo

detail.title: Neural Network-Driven Volatility Drag Mitigation under Aggressive Leverage
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a compact reformulation of a modular endto-end neural network for global minimum-variance portfolio optimization that decouples model complexity from both look-back window length and universe size. A five-parameter hyperbolic weighted moving average combined with a saturating exponential replaces the original 2,400-parameter lag-transformation layer, and a bidirectional gated-recurrent-unit eigencleaning module together with a streamlined marginal-volatility network reduce total learnable parameters from 39,586 to just 2,175. In out-of-sample tests against state-of-the-art nonlinear-shrinkage and risk-parity benchmarks, the compact network attains the lowest realized portfolio variance without compromising expected return. Under long-only constraints, the variance reduction supports substantially higher leverage while maintaining comparable drawdown control. Validation in a high-fidelity trading simulator that incorporates realistic margin-call dynamics confirms enhanced over-leverage resilience. These findings demonstrate that end-to-end variance-minimization architectures can achieve substantial parameter efficiency and robust capital-efficiency gains without sacrificing risk-adjusted performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种紧凑的端到端神经网络架构，用于全局最小方差投资组合优化，将模型复杂度与回望窗口长度和投资组合规模解耦。通过使用五参数双曲加权移动平均和饱和指数替代原有2400参数的滞后变换层，以及双向门控循环单元特征清洗模块和简化的边际波动率网络，将可学习参数从39,586减少到2,175。在样本外测试中，该紧凑网络在不牺牲预期收益的情况下实现了最低的实际投资组合方差。
AI.research_question: 如何设计参数高效的端到端神经网络架构来实现全局最小方差投资组合优化？
AI.motivation: 现有的端到端神经网络投资组合优化模型参数过多，复杂度高，需要开发更紧凑高效的架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全局最小方差投资组合理论，结合神经网络架构优化和参数效率理论。
AI.method: 使用五参数双曲加权移动平均和饱和指数替代复杂滞后变换层，采用双向门控循环单元进行特征清洗，构建简化的边际波动率网络。
AI.findings: 紧凑网络在样本外测试中实现了最低的实际投资组合方差，同时保持预期收益；在仅做多约束下，方差降低支持更高的杠杆率且保持相似的回撤控制；在高保真交易模拟器中验证了增强的过度杠杆弹性。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了端到端方差最小化架构可以实现显著的参数效率，为神经网络在投资组合优化中的应用提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了参数更少但性能不降的投资组合优化模型，在实际交易中能够实现更高的资本效率和过度杠杆弹性。

title: Fast-Spiking Neurons in Monkey Orbitofrontal Cortex Underlie Economic Value Computation
affiliations: University of Tsukuba, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), University of Tsukuba - Medical Sciences and University of Tsukuba - Division of Biomedical Science

detail.title: Fast-Spiking Neurons in Monkey Orbitofrontal Cortex Underlie Economic Value Computation
detail.abstract: Inhibitory interneurons are fundamental constituents of cortical circuits that process information to shape economic behaviors. However, the role of inhibitory interneurons in this process remains elusive in the core cortical reward region, the orbitofrontal cortex (OFC). Here, we show that presumed parvalbumin-containing GABAergic interneurons (fast-spiking neurons, FSNs) resemble regular-spiking pyramidal neurons (RSNs) in computing economic value. While monkeys perceived a visual lottery for probability and magnitude of rewards, identified FSNs comprised 12% of OFC neurons, showing high-frequency firing rates and wide dynamic ranges, both are key intrinsic cellular characteristics regulating cortical computation. We found that FSNs showed similar neural signals to RSNs in encoding probability and magnitude information. Unambiguously, both neural populations signaled the expected values, but RSNs processed the reward information more strongly, governed by the dynamic range. Thus, shared cooperative information processing between FSNs and RSNs may provide a common cortical framework for computing economic value.

detail.abstract: We test whether new condominium construction generates vacancies in a local housing market through induced moves. Using detailed address-history microdata, we track households who moved into a newly built 512-unit condominium tower in Honolulu, Hawai'i, which included both market-rate and incomerestricted units. We identify prior addresses and follow vacancy chains across multiple rounds of moves. The vacated homes were substantially cheaper than the new units and spanned diverse locations and housing types. Income-restricted units produced fewer secondary vacancies, but those vacancies were concentrated at lower price points. Our results show that new condominium construction eases supply constraints and expands affordability in a local housing market, and the contrast between market-rate and income-restricted units has important implications for inclusionary zoning policies.

detail.abstract: We develop a continuous-time regime-transition model that endogenizes the stabilization intensity π and delivers an empirically identifiable threshold π crit. When π > π crit , the dynamics converge uniquely to a conservative steady state, and the dominant eigenvalue pins down the convergence rate and defines a "political half-life." In a neighborhood of the threshold, a global-games refinement with arbitrarily small incomplete information selects the risk-dominant path. Constructing a continuous measure D of democracy together with a panel-threshold method, we identify π crit in the data and calibrate the implied half-life, thereby tying both the onset and the tempo of stabilization to a single threshold law.

title: Eco-Efficiency of Cultivated Land Use in the Songhua River Basin: Insights From Water Footprint and Spatiotemporal Modeling

detail.title: Eco-Efficiency of Cultivated Land Use in the Songhua River Basin: Insights From Water Footprint and Spatiotemporal Modeling
detail.abstract: Enhancing the eco-efficiency of cultivated land utilization (ECLU) is critical for sustainable agriculture. This study evaluates the ECLU in China's Songhua River Basin (2000–2020) by integrating the blue-green and grey water footprints into a novel input-output framework. Using the SBM-Undesirable model, we find the average ECLU exhibited a fluctuating upward trend, increasing from 0.42 to 0.53. Spatially, a distinct “upstream > midstream > downstream” gradient was observed. The Global Malmquist-Luenberger index revealed technological progress as the primary driver of improvement. However, kernel density estimation showed regional disparities intensified, evolving into a multi-peak pattern. Geographically and Temporally Weighted Regression (GTWR) analysis further identified water footprint and pesticide inputs as persistent inhibitors, while sown area and labor concentration became positive contributors later. Our findings underscore the spatiotemporal heterogeneity of ECLU and its drivers, providing a scientific basis for formulating differentiated land and water management policies to achieve synergistic gains in grain production and ecological conservation.

title: Mughal India: The World's Richest Economy in the 17th Century

detail.title: Mughal India: The World's Richest Economy in the 17th Century
detail.abstract: In the 17th century, the Mughal Empire was the world's richest economy, accounting for about 24% of world GDP and reigning supreme in international trade through its international trade networks and sophisticated administration. Despite this historical importance, the economic achievements of Mughal India are often forgotten in global discourse, obscured by Eurocentric narratives that stress the later rise of Europe and subsequent colonialism. This paper examines the structural underpinnings of the empire's prosperity. These will be investigated through a look at the land revenue systems of the empire, monetized fiscal administration, urban commercial centers, and artisanal manufacturing networks. Situating India within the wider global economy of the early modern period, it uncovers trade surpluses and primacy in shaping international commerce. Beyond documenting economic statistics, this study makes the case for the necessity of considering legacy on the Indian subcontinent in understanding not only past global dynamics but also contemporary debates on development and economic self-concept. By revisiting this piece of overlooked history, this paper contributes to a fuller narrative of global economic evolution and world history in general.

declarations.funderStatement: This project was funded by Energy Consumers Australia (ECA) with a collaboration grant.

detail.abstract:
Australian First Nations households and communities accessing electricity through prepayment arrangements experience extremely high levels of energy insecurity0F. In many cases, there is an absence of consumer protections, financial hardship assistance, or debt and disconnection relief1F. Until recently, these arrangements have largely avoided scrutiny.

While awareness of prepayment for electricity has improved3 , our research is the first national project to shine a spotlight on the previously hidden experiences of First Nations households using prepayment. The research incorporates household surveys and household-level energy use data to show that frequent disconnections are impacting food security, health, wellbeing and economic participation for First Nations prepayment customers. Australia is entering a new era of energy-driven economic development, powered by the potential of lower cost renewables. The consent for access to First Nations’ extensive land and sea estates will be needed4 . It is incumbent on leaders and policymakers to recognise those same communities remain at risk of being left behind; underserved by policy and regulation to pursue opportunities that would secure their own energy futures. To overcome these structural disadvantages Australian governments must be guided by existing frameworks, including the First Nations Clean Energy Strategy and Closing the Gap targets, and take action to ensure regulators and energy retailers work together to improve the experiences of First Nations people across all key reform areas. There is considerable scope and opportunity for existing processes to include prepayment customers, and to bring regulation, reporting requirements and policy responses for prepayment customers in line with National Energy Market rules and regulatory standards. Energy is an essential service that must be accessible by all, regardless of billing arrangements, location or income level. This can be achieved through the application of a nationally consistent consumer protection framework and guaranteed service levels for all customer groups. The overarching goal of this research and associated proposals for prepayment reform is to keep First Nations people connected to power. This is consistent with wider recognition of energy as an essential service and that noone should be disconnected due to inability to afford the energy they need.

detail.title: Features Of the Multinational Companies Transformation and Problems of Coordinating Corporate Strategies
detail.abstract: Geopolitical shifts and shocks that have intensified in recent years affect the performance of numerous corporate structures to varying degrees. Corporations operating within the borders of one state are forced to adapt to fewer external variables, while multinational companies (hereinafter referred to as MNCs) are influenced by a significant number of exogenous factors in many countries of presence. One of the distinctive features of MNCs is the presence of key stakeholders, including majority shareholders, from different countries. At the same time, the structure of MNCs predetermines the development and implementation of many interconnected strategies: basic, portfolio, competitive, functional, and others, at different levels of management, in differentiated institutional conditions. This requires the use of specific tools and methods of change management. Research methods: primarily theoretical methods (analysis; synthesis, abstraction, interpretation, etc.), empirical methods (observation, measurement, comparison), systemic-structural approach; bibliographic research method. The results of the study allow us to conclude that multinational companies in the conditions of geopolitical shocks have internal transformation capabilities that allow them to adapt to new conditions and restrictions by managing the organizational structure and internal variables. One of the results of the study was the author's substantiated proposals for the formation and use of a set of tools ("mixed tools")-a holistic, consistent set of tools for coordinating changes in MNC development strategies.

detail.abstract: Policy making is a very multifaceted process of governance, which must widen its horizons with the changing nature of the society. Specifically, when the policy deals with the factor which is not only a commodity but also the measure of value and store of value i.e. MONEY and monetary policy. Digital currencies is a new age tool to control, manage and supervise the emerging markets of the world. The digital currencies will and are widening the horizons of the market transactions by making them more and more inclusive, transparent and justifiable. The paper intends to study the potential impact of digital currencies on monetary policy, the monetary transmission mechanism, financial stability and financial inclusion. The impact is such that it promotes digital payment due to its status of being a legal tender, the accesses of digital payments is absolutely not limited to boundaries therefore inclusivity, it reduces the transaction costs and also reduces the pressure of minting money and has the potential to promise secure payments with no frauds. The study evaluates the opportunities and challenges for digitalized economy on the basis of case studies, some pilot projects by global organizations, empirical data collected by NSSO – National Sample Survey Office, CMIE – Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy, NPCI – National Payments Corporation of India In Indian context, particularly the Central Bank Digital Currency ‘E-Rupee’ presents India with a definite chance to strengthen monetary policy, enhance financial stability and extend financial inclusion. With the help of existing fintech infrastructure and international pilot projects by Bank of England, European Central bank and many more, Reserve Bank of India can design and implement a robust policy framework to derive maximum efficiency from every transaction.
