title: Is Money Money? Digital Currencies, Moneyness, and the Future of the Legal Fiction of Money
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Is Money Money? Digital Currencies, Moneyness, and the Future of the Legal Fiction of Money
detail.abstract: Most academic analyses on the “money” status of cryptocurrency are performed either formalistically or superficially. The paper on the subject and the unity of conclusions are suggestive of this fact. These assessments religiously ask whether cryptocurrencies meet "definitive" standards of "money-ness" in monetary economics. They would mostly resolve that cryptocurrencies do not. This article examines misassumptions about the fundamental nature of money manifest in the approach of these assessments and makes a case for a more comprehensive examination of the money status of cryptocurrency. By extension, it leverages the conversation on the money status of cryptocurrency as a launch pad to conduct long overdue reevaluations of our understanding of moneyness. In so doing, it explores, through economic, legal, and ontological accounts resurfaced by the conversation on cryptocurrency, the gaps between what we know about money and what we think we know about money. The paper argues for what money is and is not, reconsiders the money status of cryptocurrency, and broadly examines the future of moneyness, borrowing lessons from the digital revolution offered by Bitcoin.

AI.tldr: 本文批判现有对加密货币货币地位的评估方法，认为这些评估过于形式化和表面化，并基于经济、法律和本体论视角重新审视货币本质，重新评估加密货币的货币地位。

title: The Preah Vihear Stalemate: A Case Study in Post-Colonial Petulance and a Pathway to ASEAN Maturity
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Preah Vihear Stalemate: A Case Study in Post-Colonial Petulance and a Pathway to ASEAN Maturity
detail.abstract: This policy brief analyzes the protracted Thailand-Cambodia dispute over the Preah Vihear temple as a case study in the failure of mature conflict resolution within ASEAN. It argues that despite definitive rulings from the International Court of Justice (ICJ) affirming Cambodian sovereignty, the conflict persists due to Thailand's "strategic non-compliance"—a form of political tantrum driven by domestic nationalism. The brief contends that ASEAN's principle of non-interference has been exploited, enabling this costly and irrational stalemate that undermines regional stability and economic potential. To break the deadlock, the brief calls for ASEAN to evolve from a passive observer into an active facilitator. It proposes a three-pronged approach: reframing the issue as the management of a settled legal case, applying peer pressure through a joint cost-benefit analysis of the conflict, and championing a face-saving Joint Development Zone. The conclusion is that ASEAN must assert its role in enforcing international norms and fostering a future of shared prosperity, thereby rendering post-colonial petulance obsolete.

AI.tldr: 本文分析泰国-柬埔寨柏威夏寺争端作为东盟内部成熟冲突解决失败的案例研究，指出尽管国际法院确认柬埔寨主权，但泰国因国内民族主义采取"战略性不遵守"，导致冲突持续。东盟不干涉原则被利用，造成代价高昂的僵局。建议东盟转变为积极调解者，通过重新框架问题、施加同行压力、推动联合开发区来打破僵局。

title: Bank Demand and Sovereign Debt Management
affiliations: Utrecht University - School of Economics and ESCP Business School

detail.title: Bank Demand and Sovereign Debt Management
detail.abstract: This paper studies how banks shape sovereign debt issuance decisions. We argue that banks have an intrinsic preference for sovereign bonds with relatively short maturities; governments should respond to higher expected demand from banks by issuing shorter-maturity, lower-yield debt. Using detailed bank-level data on sovereign holdings across 27 European countries, and focusing on deposit-flow-induced demand from non-domestic banks, we isolate exogenous shifts in banks demand. Bank demand appears to significantly reduce the average maturity and yield of new long-term sovereign debt, but it does not increase total net issuance. Bond-level evidence confirms that the effects of bank demand on the primary market is concentrated in relatively short-tenor instruments, highlighting a compositional--but not extensive--adjustment in sovereign debt management.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现银行对短期主权债券有内在偏好，当银行需求增加时，政府会发行期限更短、收益率更低的债务，但不会增加总发行量。
AI.research_question: 银行如何影响主权债务发行决策？

AI.practical_contributions: 为政府债务管理提供了实证依据，帮助理解银行需求变化对主权债务市场的影响

title: Determinants of Market Income Inequality: Accounting for Model Uncertainty and Reverse Causality
affiliations: Cracow University of Economics, Lazarski University, Lazarski University, Department of Applied Economics and Lazarski University

detail.title: Determinants of Market Income Inequality: Accounting for Model Uncertainty and Reverse Causality

declarations.funderStatement: This article was prepared within the research project “Bayesian simultaneous equations model averaging - theoretical development and R package,” funded by the Polish National Science Centre, on the basis of the decision No. DEC-2021/43/B/HS4/01745.

detail.abstract: This paper reexamines the determinants of market-income inequality using a dynamic panel framework that simultaneously addresses model uncertainty and reverse causality. The approach evaluates a wide set of potential drivers without relying on a single specification and explicitly accounts for the endogeneity of core regressors. The results point to a small group of robust correlates of market-income inequality. Higher human capital is associated with higher inequality, consistent with environments where technological change disproportionately rewards high-skill workers and educational improvements remain uneven. Investment also displays a positive association with inequality, likely reflecting capital deepening and technology upgrading that complement skilled labor. Higher labor shares likewise coincide with higher inequality, suggesting that dispersion originates primarily within labor markets. Government consumption is positively linked to inequality, indicating that non-redistributive spending may favor politically influential groups. By contrast, commonly emphasized factors-such as trade, growth, financial development, redistribution, and institutional quality-exhibit unstable effects once endogeneity and model uncertainty are accounted for.

AI.tldr: 本文使用动态面板框架重新审视市场收入不平等的决定因素，同时处理模型不确定性和反向因果关系。研究发现只有少数因素与市场收入不平等稳健相关：人力资本、投资、劳动份额和政府消费与不平等正相关，而贸易、增长、金融发展等常用因素在考虑内生性后效果不稳定。
AI.research_question: 市场收入不平等的稳健决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统研究市场收入不平等决定因素的方法存在模型不确定性和内生性问题，需要更严谨的方法来识别真正稳健的相关因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态面板数据模型、内生性理论、模型不确定性理论
AI.method: 动态面板框架，同时处理模型不确定性和反向因果关系，评估广泛潜在驱动因素
AI.findings: 人力资本、投资、劳动份额和政府消费与市场收入不平等正相关；贸易、增长、金融发展、再分配和制度质量等因素在考虑内生性后效果不稳定
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了更严谨的方法论框架来识别市场收入不平等的稳健决定因素，挑战了传统研究中一些常见因素的稳定性

title: Mapping Intersectional Aging Vulnerabilities in Aragón: A New GIS Methodology from a Gender Perspective

detail.title: Mapping Intersectional Aging Vulnerabilities in Aragón: A New GIS Methodology from a Gender Perspective

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest. The funders had no role in the design of the study; in the collection, analyses, or interpretation of data; in the writing of the manuscript; or in the decision to publish the results.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research does not require an ethics approval statement.

declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: The research does not require a clinical trial registration.

detail.abstract: The research aims to develop an evidence-based feminist methodology to address aging vulnerability in the region of Aragón in Spain. The study is motivated by Spain’s demographic aging and caregiving crisis, caused by an increased aging population, life expectancy, and prevalence of age-related illnesses. The investigation targets the gender specific challenges of caregiving, highlighting women’s predominant roles in care practices. The main novelty of the study lies in integrating feminist epistemology and situated knowledge theories to quantify and map aging vulnerability, an approach previously unexplored in the context of regional planning and aging studies. Seventeen intersectional indicators, based on open-source municipal data across six dimensions (demographic aging, dependency, gender, aged care, healthcare, and territorial structure), are mapped using GIS tools and data-driven decision-making methods. The indicators are classified according to risk levels to visualize areas with higher aging vulnerability. The findings show Aragón’s territorial disparities and challenges in demographic aging, gender gaps among older adults, and regional variations in aged care and healthcare access. The study offers policymakers a holistic roadmap for efficient resource allocation, promoting sustainable strategies to enhance the well-being of older adults in Aragón and other regions facing similar challenges.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种基于证据的女权主义方法，用于评估西班牙阿拉贡地区的老龄化脆弱性。通过整合女权主义认识论和情境知识理论，使用17个交叉指标和GIS工具来量化和绘制老龄化脆弱性地图，为政策制定者提供资源分配和可持续战略的路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种基于证据的女权主义方法来评估和解决西班牙阿拉贡地区的老龄化脆弱性问题？
AI.motivation: 西班牙面临人口老龄化和护理危机，由老龄化人口增加、预期寿命延长和与年龄相关疾病流行引起。研究关注护理中的性别特定挑战，强调女性在护理实践中的主导作用。

AI.method: 基于开源市政数据的17个交叉指标，涵盖六个维度（人口老龄化、依赖性、性别、老年护理、医疗保健和区域结构），使用GIS工具和数据驱动决策方法进行映射。
AI.findings: 阿拉贡地区存在区域差异，在人口老龄化、老年人性别差距以及老年护理和医疗保健获取的区域差异方面面临挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将女权主义认识论和情境知识理论整合到区域规划和老龄化研究中，为老龄化脆弱性研究提供了新的理论框架。

title: Does Auction Design Facilitate Collusion?
affiliations: , Xiamen University Malaysia Campus, Sichuan University - Business School and Xiamen University

detail.title: Does Auction Design Facilitate Collusion?
detail.abstract: This paper examines how auction design can unintentionally facilitate bidder collusion in land market. Departing from the dominant view that attributes low land concession revenues to corruption, we highlight how features of auction structure enable bidderside collusion, suppressing sale prices. Using a dataset of land auctions from 15 Chinese cities (2006-2016), we find that two-stage (listing) auctions are significantly more susceptible to collusion than one-stage formats. Empirical evidence shows that sales concluding at the (secret) reserve price occur disproportionately in two-stage auctions, even after controlling for land and market characteristics. We argue that the transparency and sequencing of two-stage auctions, while designed to enhance fairness, inadvertently reduce monitoring costs and facilitate tacit bidder coordination. Our findings underscore the need to jointly consider auction format and reserve price policy in designing land sales to enhance market efficiency and mitigate collusion risks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，土地拍卖的两阶段设计无意中促进了竞标者合谋，导致土地出让收入降低。通过分析中国15个城市2006-2016年的土地拍卖数据，发现两阶段拍卖比单阶段拍卖更容易出现合谋行为，表现为大量交易以底价成交。

title: The European Liquidity Gap
affiliations: University of Utah - David Eccles School of Business,  and ESCP Business School

detail.title: The European Liquidity Gap
detail.abstract: The perception that European stocks are less liquid than those in the United States (US) is only partially true. Controlling for firm size, we find that large European stocks have caught up and now have liquidity on par with their US peers. European small-caps, however, remain 70% more expensive to trade than similar stocks in the US. This "liquidity gap" is wider for stocks with lower exchange competition, lower free float, listed at smaller exchange groups, in countries with lower retail ownership. The evidence highlights liquidity as a defining constraint of Europe's capital market competitiveness.

title: Brief of Amicus Curiae of the National Women's Law Center in Support of Respondents: BRADLEY LITTLE v. LINDSAY HECOX and WEST VIRGINIA v. B.P.J., Supreme Court of the United States, Nos. 24-38, 24-43

detail.title: Brief of Amicus Curiae of the National Women's Law Center in Support of Respondents: BRADLEY LITTLE v. LINDSAY HECOX and WEST VIRGINIA v. B.P.J., Supreme Court of the United States, Nos. 24-38, 24-43

publicationDetails.detailsText: Supreme Court of the United States, Nos., 24-38, 24-43
U. of Pittsburgh Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2025-37
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Pittsburgh School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In this pair of cases, Little v. Hecox and West Virginia v. B.P.J., the Supreme Court will hear challenges to two state laws restricting transgender girls from participation in girls' sports. This amicus brief, submitted by the National Women's Law Center, argues that these state laws violate Title IX, which bars all persons from being excluded from, denied the benefits of, or otherwise discriminated against in any education program or activity receiving federal funds on the basis of such individual's sex. Title IX quite literally bars excluding transgender girls from girls' sports, as these laws do, based on their "biological sex." While the Title IX regulations, adopted in 1975, permit--under specified conditions and with certain limitations--offering separate girls' and boys' sports teams, neither the letter nor purposes of the Title IX regulations authorize the wholesale exclusion of transgender girls from girls' sports as these laws undertake to do. Not only do these laws deny transgender girls the educational benefits of sports, they reinforce the very stereotypes of female frailty that Title IX was intended to combat and discriminate against all girls and women in sports by rendering them vulnerable to sexual surveillance and intrusive challenges to their identity.

AI.tldr: 美国最高法院将审理两起挑战州法律禁止跨性别女孩参加女子体育赛事的案件。全国妇女法律中心提交的法庭之友陈述认为这些州法律违反《教育法修正案第九条》，该法案禁止基于性别在教育项目中歧视任何人。
AI.research_question: 州法律禁止跨性别女孩参加女子体育赛事是否违反《教育法修正案第九条》？
AI.motivation: 保护跨性别女孩的体育参与权利，防止基于性别刻板印象的歧视，维护《教育法修正案第九条》的立法宗旨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 《教育法修正案第九条》法律框架、性别歧视理论、反刻板印象原则。
AI.method: 法律分析、案例研究、法规解释。
AI.findings: 州法律全面禁止跨性别女孩参加女子体育违反了《教育法修正案第九条》，强化了女性脆弱的刻板印象，对所有女孩和妇女构成歧视。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清《教育法修正案第九条》对跨性别学生权利的保护范围，发展反性别刻板印象的法律理论。

title: OpenGloss: A Synthetic Encyclopedic Dictionary and Semantic Knowledge Graph
affiliations: 273 Ventures

detail.title: OpenGloss: A Synthetic Encyclopedic Dictionary and Semantic Knowledge Graph
detail.abstract:
We present OpenGloss, a synthetic encyclopedic dictionary and semantic knowledge graph for English that integrates lexicographic definitions, encyclopedic context, etymological histories, and semantic relationships in a unified resource. OpenGloss contains 537K senses across 150K lexemes, on par with WordNet 3.1 and Open English WordNet, while providing more than four times as many sense definitions. These lexemes include 9.1M semantic edges, 1M usage examples, 3M collocations, and 60M words of encyclopedic content. 

Generated through a multi-agent procedural generation pipeline with schema-validated LLM outputs and automated quality assurance, the entire resource was produced in under one week for under $1,000. This demonstrates that structured generation can create comprehensive lexical resources at cost and time scales impractical for manual curation, enabling rapid iteration as foundation models improve. The resource addresses gaps in pedagogical applications by providing integrated content-definitions, examples, collocations, encyclopedias, etymology that supports both vocabulary learning and natural language processing tasks. 

As a synthetically generated resource, OpenGloss reflects both the capabilities and limitations of current foundation models. The dataset is publicly available on Hugging Face under CC-BY 4.0, enabling researchers and educators to build upon and adapt this resource.

AI.tldr: OpenGloss是一个合成的英语百科全书词典和语义知识图谱，整合了词典定义、百科全书背景、词源历史和语义关系。该资源包含53.7万个词义和15万个词条，通过多智能体程序生成管道在1周内以低于1000美元的成本创建，展示了结构化生成在创建全面词汇资源方面的潜力。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结构化生成方法创建全面且成本效益高的词汇资源，以解决现有词汇资源的局限性？
AI.motivation: 现有词汇资源如WordNet在规模、内容和更新速度方面存在限制，手动编纂成本高且耗时长。需要开发能够快速迭代、集成多种语言信息且成本可控的新型词汇资源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于结构化生成理论、多智能体系统框架和语义知识图谱构建理论，结合大规模语言模型的能力来创建综合词汇资源。
AI.method: 采用多智能体程序生成管道，结合模式验证的LLM输出和自动化质量保证，在1周内以低于1000美元的成本生成整个资源。
AI.findings: 成功创建了包含53.7万个词义、15万个词条、910万语义边、100万使用示例、300万搭配和6000万词百科全书内容的综合资源，规模与WordNet 3.1相当但定义数量多四倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了结构化生成方法在创建全面词汇资源方面的可行性，为快速迭代词汇资源提供了理论基础，展示了生成式AI在语言学资源构建中的潜力。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了公开可用的综合词汇资源，支持词汇学习和自然语言处理任务，为教育应用和NLP研究提供了实用工具，展示了低成本快速生成语言资源的可行性。

title: Do Pre-K Programs Improve Parental Mental Health? Evidence from Contrasting Universal and Targeted Pre-K Models
affiliations: University of Connecticut at Waterbury - Department of Economics

detail.title: Do Pre-K Programs Improve Parental Mental Health? Evidence from Contrasting Universal and Targeted Pre-K Models
detail.abstract: Caring for young children places a substantial burden on parents, and evidence indicates that these responsibilities can undermine parental mental health. Early childhood education (ECE) programs are designed to alleviate childcare burdens by providing childcare service. This study evaluates the impact of one of the most prominent ECE initiatives in US-state-funded pre-kindergarten (pre-K) programs-on parental mental health. The analysis distinguishes between two major types of pre-K programs: universal and targeted. Leveraging age-based eligibility rules for identification, I conduct a state by age difference-indifference design, the findings indicate that universal pre-K programs significantly enhance parental mental health among lowincome families, whereas targeted programs do not yield comparable benefits. The disparity in outcomes between the two program types may be attributed to differences in classroom diversity and peer effects. Two primary mechanisms are identified as contributing to the program effect: (1) a reduction in time devoted to child-rearing, and (2) improvements in children's behavioral development, which may facilitate a better parents-child communication. The evidence suggests that the latter plays a much more substantial role. These results highlight that the benefits of early education programs extend beyond child outcomes, generating meaningful positive spillover effects on parental well-being.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了美国州资助的学前班项目对父母心理健康的影响，发现普惠性学前班显著改善低收入家庭父母心理健康，而针对性项目无类似效果。机制分析表明，儿童行为发展的改善比育儿时间减少发挥更大作用。
AI.research_question: 普惠性和针对性学前班项目对父母心理健康的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 育儿负担严重影响父母心理健康，早期教育项目旨在减轻育儿负担，但其对父母心理健康的具体影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于育儿负担理论、同伴效应理论和儿童发展理论，探讨学前班项目通过减少育儿时间和改善儿童行为发展影响父母心理健康的机制。
AI.method: 利用年龄资格规则，采用州-年龄双重差分设计进行识别分析。
AI.findings: 普惠性学前班显著改善低收入家庭父母心理健康，针对性项目无类似效果；儿童行为发展改善比育儿时间减少发挥更大作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了早期教育项目溢出效应的理论框架，揭示了项目类型差异对父母心理健康的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计更有效的早期教育项目提供了实证依据，强调普惠性项目在改善家庭整体福祉方面的重要价值。

title: The Mind Behind the Margin: A Behavioral Economics Approach to the Gender Pay Gap

detail.title: The Mind Behind the Margin: A Behavioral Economics Approach to the Gender Pay Gap

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal conflicts of interest. This research was conducted under the academic supervision of Dr. Swati Upveja, whose guidance was limited to scholarly mentorship and did not influence the findings or interpretations presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or primary data collection. All data analyzed were obtained from publicly available secondary sources; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The persistence of the gender pay gap in global labor markets, despite advancements in education and policy reforms, proves that wage disparities represent a deeply rooted challenge that significantly impedes social and economic development within society. Women in India earn approximately 72% of what men earn for comparable work. Traditional explanations focusing on human capital factors, like education, work experience, professional choices or career interruptions, fail to fully account for the perpetual state of this discrepancy. This implies that conventional economic variables alone are insufficient to explain the widening gender pay gap, and thus is imperative to seek a behavioural approach to further examine the issue at hand. This paper employs a behavioral economics framework to examine how negotiation behaviors, risk preferences, and implicit biases contribute to wage differentials. The paper analyses seminal studies and case studies from the Indian context and estimates that these behavioral factors account for approximately 10-25% of the wage gap. The paper lastly concludes with policy recommendations aimed at mitigating these behavioral contributors to wage inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文采用行为经济学框架分析印度性别工资差距，发现谈判行为、风险偏好和隐性偏见等行为因素可解释10-25%的工资差距，并提出了相应的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 行为因素（谈判行为、风险偏好和隐性偏见）如何影响印度的性别工资差距？
AI.motivation: 尽管教育和政策改革取得进展，全球劳动力市场中性别工资差距仍然持续存在，传统的人力资本因素无法完全解释这一差距，需要从行为经济学角度深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学框架，重点关注谈判行为、风险偏好和隐性偏见理论。
AI.method: 分析经典研究和印度背景的案例研究。
AI.findings: 行为因素（谈判行为、风险偏好和隐性偏见）可以解释印度性别工资差距的10-25%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为性别工资差距研究提供了行为经济学的理论视角，补充了传统人力资本理论的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了针对行为因素的政策建议，旨在减轻工资不平等问题。

title: Progressive carbon taxation for a just transition: Scenarios from an Integrated Assessment Model with heterogeneous households
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Pisa, University of Pisa, University of Pisa and University of Pisa

detail.title: Progressive carbon taxation for a just transition: Scenarios from an Integrated Assessment Model with heterogeneous households
detail.abstract: Carbon taxes are a key tool for reducing greenhouse gas emissions but they tend to burden low-income households disproportionately. A common recommendation is to complement them with redistributive transfers. In this paper, we propose a progressive carbon tax for Italy that targets only non-essential emissions, by which the government fully reimburses households up to a threshold reflecting basic energy needs. The policy is assessed on its own and in combination with structural green transition scenarios of electrification and renewable energy. We simulate these scenarios using Eurogreen+, a demand driven macroeconomic model featuring an input-output structure that integrates physical and monetary energy flows and features 100 heterogeneous households. This framework allows us to capture the effects of the carbon tax throughout the economy and on households’ consumption composition, and to compute carbon footprints for implementing the reimbursement mechanism. We find that while the carbon tax alone increases income inequality, the progressive design prevents such regressive outcomes while achieving comparable emission reductions. These outcomes persist when the carbon tax is combined with structural energy transition policies, which achieve significant emissions' reduction and deeper de-carbonization. Our results highlight the necessity of combining market-based instruments with redistributive and systemic approaches to climate policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对意大利的渐进式碳税方案，仅对非必需排放征税，并为家庭提供基本能源需求补偿。研究发现该方案在保持减排效果的同时避免了收入不平等加剧，强调了将市场工具与再分配和系统性方法结合的必要性。
AI.research_question: 渐进式碳税设计能否在实现减排目标的同时避免对低收入家庭造成不成比例的负担？
AI.motivation: 传统碳税往往对低收入家庭造成不成比例的负担，需要设计更公平的碳税方案来平衡减排效果和社会公平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于需求驱动的宏观经济理论，结合投入产出结构和异质性家庭模型，整合物理和货币能源流分析。
AI.method: 使用Eurogreen+宏观经济模型进行情景模拟，该模型具有投入产出结构，整合了物理和货币能源流，包含100个异质性家庭。
AI.findings: 单独碳税会增加收入不平等，但渐进式设计能防止这种倒退性结果，同时实现可比的减排效果；与能源转型政策结合时能实现更显著的减排和深度脱碳。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了渐进式碳税的理论框架，强调仅对非必需排放征税并补偿基本能源需求的概念创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了可行的渐进式碳税设计方案，展示了如何将市场工具与再分配政策结合来实现公平有效的减排。

title: Deep Learning the Financialization of Oil: A Cross-Attention Transformer Model for Forecasting Crude Oil Prices with Equity and Currency Volatility
affiliations: Quaid-i-Azam University - School of Management Sciences, Quaid-i-Azam University, Quaid-i-Azam University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Lisbon, Quaid-i-Azam University and University of Sannio

detail.title: Deep Learning the Financialization of Oil: A Cross-Attention Transformer Model for Forecasting Crude Oil Prices with Equity and Currency Volatility
detail.abstract: The fact that the world energy markets are becoming increasingly or becoming more financialised has reinforced the interconnection between the prices of oil, equity performance, and currency volatility. It is in this manner that this study seeks to predict the prices of crude oil by studying these interdependencies using sophisticated deep learning models. Monthly data given between 2010 and 2025 of 10 developed economies were used to test seven models: TCN, BiGRU, Transformer, Cross-Attention Transformer, CNN-LSTM, BiLSTM, and Attention-LSTM. The Attention-LSTM performed best (MAE = 171.76, RMSE = 188.71) and predicted the Brent price in the range of USD 90-92 per barrel in November 2025-March 2026. The research paper concludes that the dynamics of oil prices are mainly guided by equity and currency volatilities; hence, oil is a financialised commodity. It suggests the incorporation of financial indicators in the energy forecasting and policy designs. It can be concluded that the findings suggest methodological and even theoretical progress in energy economics. The disadvantages are the lack of high-frequency data and a small geographical area.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用深度学习模型预测原油价格，发现Attention-LSTM模型表现最佳，预测2025年11月至2026年3月布伦特原油价格在90-92美元/桶之间。研究证实油价动态主要由股票和汇率波动引导，表明石油已成为金融化商品。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度学习模型通过研究石油价格、股票表现和汇率波动之间的相互依赖关系来预测原油价格？
AI.motivation: 世界能源市场日益金融化，加强了石油价格、股票表现和汇率波动之间的相互联系，这为使用先进深度学习模型预测原油价格提供了机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源金融化理论、深度学习理论、时间序列预测理论
AI.method: 使用2010-2025年10个发达经济体的月度数据，测试了7种深度学习模型：TCN、BiGRU、Transformer、Cross-Attention Transformer、CNN-LSTM、BiLSTM和Attention-LSTM
AI.findings: Attention-LSTM模型表现最佳（MAE = 171.76，RMSE = 188.71），预测2025年11月至2026年3月布伦特原油价格在90-92美元/桶之间；油价动态主要由股票和汇率波动引导
AI.theory_contributions: 证实石油是金融化商品，为能源经济学提供了方法论和理论进展
AI.practical_contributions: 建议在能源预测和政策设计中纳入金融指标，为能源市场参与者提供更准确的预测工具

title: The Theory of Man-Made Disaster Structure: A Historical Model of Human Incapacitation in Imperial China

detail.title: The Theory of Man-Made Disaster Structure: A Historical Model of Human Incapacitation in Imperial China

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Jules Vela, declare that I have no personal or financial relationships with any individuals or organizations that could inappropriately influence or be perceived to influence this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve patients or clinical participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author and did not receive any external financial support.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes the Theory of Man-Made Disaster Structure, arguing that the recurring mass famines and social collapses in Chinese history-from the Shang to the Qing dynasties-were not natural disasters (tianzai), but consequences of systematic incapacitation engineered through state institutions. This model defines a human incapacitation system that gradually stripped individuals of material, physical, and psychological autonomy, forming a structure of chronic vulnerability. The paper identifies twelve interlocking mechanisms through which the state perpetuated obedience, dependence, and helplessness, ensuring regime stability through mass disablement rather than empowerment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出人为灾难结构理论，认为中国历史上从商到清反复出现的大规模饥荒和社会崩溃并非自然灾害，而是通过国家制度设计的系统性失能化后果。该模型定义了一个人类失能系统，逐步剥夺个体的物质、身体和心理自主权，形成慢性脆弱性结构。
AI.research_question: 中国历史上反复出现的大规模饥荒和社会崩溃的根本原因是什么？它们是否真的是自然灾害，还是人为制度设计的后果？
AI.motivation: 传统上中国历史上的饥荒和社会崩溃被归因于自然灾害，但作者认为需要重新审视这些事件，探究其背后是否存在系统性的制度设计因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人为灾难结构理论，人类失能系统理论，慢性脆弱性结构理论
AI.method: 历史制度分析，识别十二个相互关联的机制
AI.findings: 国家通过十二个相互关联的机制持续制造服从、依赖和无助，通过大规模失能化而非赋权来确保政权稳定。饥荒和社会崩溃是系统性失能化的后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了人为灾难结构理论，挑战了传统自然灾害解释，建立了人类失能系统的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解历史上的社会崩溃提供了新的分析视角，对现代社会治理和制度设计具有警示意义。

title: Fiscal Policy and Economic Growth in Ethiopia: Unpacking Inflation's Conditional Channels of Influence

detail.title: Fiscal Policy and Economic Growth in Ethiopia: Unpacking Inflation's Conditional Channels of Influence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest
declarations.funderStatement: The research no received any fund

detail.abstract: This study investigates how persistent inflation in Ethiopia conditionally affects the efficacy of fiscal policies in driving economic growth. Utilizing an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) approach with data from 1980 to 2023. The study contrasts a baseline model with an inflation-augmented framework to isolate both the direct and conditional effects of inflation on the fiscal policy-growth nexus, confirming a stable long-run cointegrating relationship. The findings reveal that inflation not only directly impedes longrun economic growth but also significantly alters the effectiveness of fiscal instruments. Specifically, while government expenditure and capital formation emerge as substantial positive growth drivers in the presence of inflation (a relationship not evident in the baseline model), the growth-enhancing effects of trade openness and government revenue are significantly weakened by high inflation. This study moves beyond conventional direct-effect models by explicitly demonstrating inflation's conditioning effect, providing novel empirical evidence on the nuanced fiscal policy-growth relationship in an inflation-prone developing economy like Ethiopia. This offers a more comprehensive, inflation-aware policy perspective for fostering sustainable growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了埃塞俄比亚持续通胀如何条件性地影响财政政策促进经济增长的效果。研究发现通胀不仅直接阻碍长期经济增长，还显著改变财政工具的有效性：在通胀环境下，政府支出和资本形成成为积极增长动力，但贸易开放和政府收入的增长效应被削弱。
AI.research_question: 持续通胀如何条件性地影响埃塞俄比亚财政政策促进经济增长的效果？
AI.motivation: 超越传统的直接效应模型，明确展示通胀的调节作用，为埃塞俄比亚这样的通胀易发发展中国家提供更全面的通胀感知政策视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政政策与经济增长关系理论，通胀调节效应理论
AI.method: 使用1980-2023年数据的自回归分布滞后（ARDL）方法，对比基准模型与通胀增强框架
AI.findings: 通胀直接阻碍长期经济增长；在通胀环境下，政府支出和资本形成成为积极增长动力；贸易开放和政府收入的增长效应被高通胀削弱
AI.theory_contributions: 超越传统直接效应模型，明确展示通胀的调节作用，为财政政策-增长关系提供新的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为埃塞俄比亚等通胀易发发展中国家提供更全面的通胀感知政策视角，促进可持续增长

title: The post-Keynesian Three-Equation Model: An Alternative to the New Keynesian DSGE Model

detail.title: The post-Keynesian Three-Equation Model: An Alternative to the New Keynesian DSGE Model
detail.abstract: This paper develops a post-Keynesian system dynamics macroeconomic model as an alternative to the New Keynesian (NK) Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium (DSGE) framework (Clarida, Galí, & Gertler, 1999; Woodford, 2003). Although NK models are based on three core relationships: the intertemporal IS curve, the New-Keynesian Phillips Curve, and a Taylor-type monetary rule, these equations rely on optimizing agents, rational expectations, and instantaneous market clearing. Here, the same three-equation structure is reinterpreted through the lens of effective demand, income distribution, and adaptive financial behavior (Kalecki, 1954; Lavoie, 2014; Keen, 1995; Minsky, 1986). The framework extends the tradition of non-linear stock-flow consistency developed by Keen (Keen, 1995, 2011, 2013) and others, embedding Minskyan financial instability within a broader macroeconomic system that also incorporates fiscal and monetary feedbacks (Godley & Lavoie, 2007; Lerner, 1943). Expressed in continuous time, the model links output, inflation, and the interest rate through empirically motivated behavioral functions rather than microfoundations. An optional fourth equation introduces private debt as a dynamic state variable, generating endogenous instability absent from DSGE models. Simulations show that cyclical behavior, leverage dynamics, and distributional feedbacks emerge naturally from the interaction of the real, financial, and fiscal sectors. The framework demonstrates that macroeconomic stability 1 cannot be derived from the optimization of representative agents but must instead be studied as an evolving, feedback-driven process.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个后凯恩斯主义系统动力学宏观经济模型，作为新凯恩斯主义DSGE框架的替代方案。该模型基于有效需求、收入分配和适应性金融行为，将传统三方程结构重新解释，并引入私人债务作为动态状态变量，生成DSGE模型所缺乏的内生不稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个基于后凯恩斯主义理论的宏观经济模型来替代新凯恩斯主义DSGE框架？
AI.motivation: 新凯恩斯主义模型依赖于优化代理人、理性预期和瞬时市场清算等假设，而这些假设在现实中往往不成立。需要开发一个更符合实际经济行为的替代框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后凯恩斯主义经济学、凯莱斯基有效需求理论、明斯基金融不稳定性假说、戈德利-拉瓦伊存量流量一致性方法
AI.method: 系统动力学建模方法，构建连续时间宏观经济模型，包含产出、通胀和利率的行为函数，可选地引入私人债务作为第四状态变量
AI.findings: 模拟显示，周期性行为、杠杆动态和分配反馈从实体经济、金融和财政部门的相互作用中自然涌现，宏观经济稳定性不能从代表性代理人优化推导，而必须作为演化过程研究
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了新凯恩斯主义DSGE框架的替代方案，将明斯基金融不稳定性嵌入更广泛的宏观经济系统，发展了非线性存量流量一致性传统
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更贴近现实经济行为的分析工具，能够模拟内生不稳定性和金融-实体经济相互作用

title: Corporate Reporting under the EU Taxonomy Framework: A Sectoral and Geographical Analysis of Eligibility and Alignment

detail.title: Corporate Reporting under the EU Taxonomy Framework: A Sectoral and Geographical Analysis of Eligibility and Alignment
detail.abstract: This research paper analyzes the level of eligibility and alignment of economic activities reported by European companies under the EU Taxonomy framework. The analysis is based on a structured dataset that includes company level data on eligible, non-eligible, aligned and not aligned economic activities for reported KPIs (turnover, CAPEX and OPEX). Using a Chat-GPT extraction process, we collected and processed data from publicly available corporate sustainability reports published by European companies. We analysed how eligibility and alignment levels vary across industries, environmental objectives and countries. Our findings show that while eligibility levels are relatively high, alignment remains modest across all KPIs. Further analysis reveals that most aligned activities focus on climate mitigation, with limited engagement in biodiversity, water and pollution prevention objectives. The dataset compiled facilitates cross-country comparisons, sector specific benchmarking and empirical modeling of green investment patterns by supporting further research into sustainable finance, environmental policy and ESG reporting.

title: Security and Development: The Role of International Organizations in Migration Governance

detail.title: Security and Development: The Role of International Organizations in Migration Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no conflicts of interest

detail.abstract: Migration governance spans national policies, interstate agreements, multilateral forums, and the activities of international organizations, all of which shape the rules and norms that regulate cross-border mobility. Although states remain central to migration policymaking, governance has become a multilevel process involving a broad array of actors. Many governments resist ceding authority to supranational bodies, yet the global scale of migration and the limitations of national approaches underscore the need for more coordinated international frameworks. The extent of international organizational involvement varies according to states’ size, political economy, power, and geography, with small developing states, particularly island nations, facing distinct governance challenges. This paper examines how these states navigate the shifting landscape of migration governance and assesses the effectiveness of existing multilevel arrangements. The study contributes a nuanced analysis of the structural constraints and opportunities shaping small states’ migration strategies, offering insights into how global governance mechanisms can better support their needs.

detail.abstract: The quality of healthcare is more difficult to identify than other services because it is the clients themselves and their quality of life that gets evaluated (Eiriz & Figueiredu, 2005). The main aim of this study is to investigate people’s perceptions and expectations regarding the quality of services in primary health care (PHC) in Kosovo. A national level survey provides baseline findings intuitively understandable to policymakers on the expectations — perceptions of the quality of services at the PHC level and identifying the quality gap between the expectations and perceptions in all dimensions of different facilities. This comparative test will show the differences between the level of quality services provided by each PHC provider in Kosovo. This research seeks to improve the access and the quality of the priority services at PHC, including maternal and child health (MCH) and non-communicable disease (NCD). This research showed that at the national level the patients have higher expectations toward PHC services. Whereas, in specific, this study showed that there is a significant gap in expected and perceived services of the PHC system between different ethnic patients and different levels of citizen education. Therefore, the result of this study will contribute to enhancing the sustainability of the mandatory health insurance reform and raise the alarm of relevant institutions to reshape the policy-making in order to improve the population health outcome.

title: The Lending Technology of Direct Lenders in Private Credit
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University, Office of Financial Research, US Department of the Treasury and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: The Lending Technology of Direct Lenders in Private Credit
detail.abstract:
We compare the lending technology of direct lenders, banks, and finance companies using a unique data set on secured borrowing by the universe of U.S.-based private middle market firms. The borrowers of direct lenders are distinct relative to those of traditional lenders; they are younger, more likely to be in intangible capital industries, and more likely to be located in the biggest cities in the United States. These differences reflect the focus of direct lenders on private equity-owned firms; direct lenders have negligible impact in industries and cities with low private equity presence. The lending technology of direct lenders is distinct from banks: they have almost no branch network, they are geographically distant from borrowers, they write collateral claims more focused on the continuation value of firms after a default, and they have a higher degree of specialization in certain industries. Direct lenders and private equity sponsors match on industry specialization more strongly than geographic proximity. The findings suggest that direct lenders are not a general substitute for traditional lenders in middle market business lending, but they are instead specialized lenders focused on a particular segment of the U.S. economy with a distinct lending technology.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Playing Catch-up with Health Savings
affiliations: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Government of the United States of America - Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) and George Mason University - School of Policy, Government, and International Affairs

detail.title: Playing Catch-up with Health Savings
detail.abstract:
We use comprehensive tax data to study how saving behavior responds to the Health Savings Account (HSA) “catch-up” contribution provision, which raises HSA contribution limits for individuals aged 55 and older. Using a regression discontinuity design, we find a sharp increase in contributions among those previously near the limit and smaller increases among unconstrained savers. Induced contributions are not immediately withdrawn and do not appear to crowd out retirement savings. Responses are strongest among payroll contributors and long-term savers. However, married couples do not appear to coordinate their HSA behavior to take advantage of the complex spousal rules governing catch-up contributions. Our findings highlight how tax incentives shape HSA saving and suggest that tax-advantaged account design meaningfully affects household financial behavior.

detail.abstract: From the perspective of intellectual property (IP) and antitrust law, the overriding question in the pharmaceutical industry is how to navigate the tradeoff between innovation and access. title: The Social Rate of Return on Road Infrastructure Investments
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill, New York University (NYU) - New York University and University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

detail.title: The Social Rate of Return on Road Infrastructure Investments
detail.abstract:
A billion people live more than two kilometers from an all-season road, the vast majority of whom reside in emerging-market and developing economies (EMDEs), where the absence of paved roads hinders growth and development. Consistent with this shortage, we estimate that the median social rate of return to installing an additional kilometer of two-lane highway in EMDEs is 55 percent—roughly eight times the social rate of return on private capital in the US. The size and precision of the estimates vary widely across countries. But the eightfold excess social return on roads is, nevertheless, five times larger than the excess financial return on stocks in developing countries that once catalyzed the creation of emerging market equity as an asset class. The absolute and relative magnitudes of these excess returns thus suggest the possibility of substantial unrealized gains from reallocating developed-country savings toward public capital formation in EMDEs. We document these facts using a production function approach to estimate each country’s marginal product of public capital (MPX). We then pair these estimates with country-specific, hedonic road-construction prices (Px) from the Roads Cost Knowledge System to compute social rates of return (Rx). Because macro estimates face well-known identification and measurement challenges, we interpret our findings alongside complementary evidence on financial and micro-level returns.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.method: 使用生产函数方法估算各国公共资本的边际产出，并与来自道路成本知识系统的国别道路建设价格相结合，计算社会回报率。

title: Malleable Minds: The Effects of STEM- vs. Humanities-Focused Curricula
affiliations: University of Florida, New York University (NYU) - Robert F. Wagner Graduate School of Public Service, University of Quebec at Montreal (UQAM) - Université du Québec à Montréal, Columbia University - School of International & Public Affairs (SIPA) and Columbia University

detail.title: Malleable Minds: The Effects of STEM- vs. Humanities-Focused Curricula
detail.abstract:
We examine the impacts of assignment to STEM vs. humanities-focused curricula in Romania’s high school system. We apply a regression discontinuity design to administrative and survey data to estimate effects on educational pathways, desired careers, and non-cognitive outcomes. An overarching theme of our findings is the malleability of students to what they study. Assignment to STEM increases STEM college enrollment and technology or engineering career intentions by 25 pp. Exploring mechanisms, we find that STEM assignment changes students’ self-perceived academic abilities and their preferences over academic subjects and job tasks. STEM assignment is risky for low-achieving students, reducing their chances of passing a high school exit exam and enrolling in college. A final finding is that STEM makes boys more conservative, while shifting some of girls' views to the left. Our results identify a strategy for promoting STEM higher education and careers, but also highlight potential tradeoffs.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用断点回归设计分析罗马尼亚高中STEM与人文课程的分配影响，发现STEM课程能显著提升学生STEM大学入学率和科技工程职业意向，但也对低成绩学生有风险，并影响学生的政治观点。
AI.research_question: STEM与人文课程分配对学生教育路径、职业意向和非认知结果的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 探讨课程设置如何塑造学生的教育选择和职业发展，以及可能的权衡效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教育经济学和课程影响理论，关注课程分配对学生行为和偏好的塑造作用。
AI.method: 使用断点回归设计分析行政和调查数据。
AI.findings: STEM课程分配使STEM大学入学率和科技工程职业意向提升25个百分点；改变学生自我认知能力和偏好；对低成绩学生有风险；影响性别政治观点差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了课程设置对学生可塑性的影响机制，拓展了教育干预的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为促进STEM高等教育和职业发展提供策略，同时警示课程分配的风险和权衡。

title: Misaligned by Design: Incentive Failures in Machine Learning
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics, New York University (NYU) - Department of Economics, University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) - Department of Economics and Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge

detail.title: Misaligned by Design: Incentive Failures in Machine Learning
detail.abstract:
The cost of error in many high-stakes settings is asymmetric: misdiagnosing pneumonia when absent is an inconvenience, but failing to detect it when present can be life-threatening. Accordingly, artificial intelligence (AI) models used to assist such decisions are frequently trained with asymmetric loss functions that incorporate human decision-makers' trade-offs between false positives and false negatives. In two focal applications, we show that this standard alignment practice can backfire. In both cases, it would be better to train the machine learning model with a loss function that ignores the human’s objective and then adjust predictions ex post according to that objective. We rationalize this result using an economic model of incentive design with endogenous information acquisition. The key insight from our theoretical framework is that machine classifiers perform not one but two incentivized tasks: choosing how to classify and learning how to classify. We show that while the adjustments engineers use correctly incentivize choosing, they can simultaneously reduce the incentives to learn. Our formal treatment of the problem reveals that methods embraced for their intuitive appeal can in fact misalign human and machine objectives in predictable ways.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 论文发现，在高风险决策中，使用非对称损失函数训练AI模型的标准做法可能适得其反。更好的方法是用对称损失函数训练模型，然后根据人类目标调整预测结果。
AI.research_question: 在高风险决策中，使用非对称损失函数训练AI模型是否是最佳实践？
AI.motivation: 许多高风险场景中错误成本是不对称的，传统做法是使用非对称损失函数来训练AI模型，但这种做法可能产生意想不到的负面后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生信息获取的激励设计经济模型，将机器学习分类器视为执行两个激励任务：分类决策和信息学习。
AI.method: 通过两个焦点应用案例进行实证分析，结合理论模型推导。
AI.findings: 标准对齐实践可能适得其反，使用对称损失函数训练模型然后事后调整预测效果更好。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了机器学习分类器同时执行分类决策和信息学习两个激励任务，传统方法可能正确激励分类决策但减少学习激励。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI模型在高风险决策中的训练提供了新的实践指导，建议采用对称损失函数训练加事后调整的方法。

title: The Spatial Distribution of Income in Cities: New Global Evidence and Theory
affiliations: Boston University, University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Department of Economics, Boston University and Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) - JICA Ogata Sadako Research Institute for Peace and Development

detail.title: The Spatial Distribution of Income in Cities: New Global Evidence and Theory
detail.abstract:
We study how the spatial distribution of income and commuting patterns within cities vary across the development spectrum, drawing on new granular data from 50,000 neighborhoods in 121 cities across developed and developing countries. We document that in developing countries, poorer urban households are significantly more likely to live far from city centers, in hilly terrain, and near rivers. These patterns are absent or reversed in developed cities. Commuting shares decline more sharply with distance in less developed countries, indicating higher commuting costs that exacerbate spatial inequality in job access. Job-access measures are considerably worse for the urban poor than for the urban rich in developing countries, while the opposite is true in developed countries. We interpret these findings in a quantitative urban model and show that a parsimonious set of factors—nonhomothetic preferences over amenities, commuting costs, and the spatial concentration of jobs—helps explain most of the cross-country patterns we document.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了121个城市中5万个社区的数据，发现在发展中国家，较贫困家庭更可能居住在远离市中心、地形陡峭和靠近河流的区域，这种模式在发达国家中不存在或相反。发展中国家的通勤成本更高，导致空间不平等加剧，而发达国家的城市贫困人口在就业机会获取方面反而更好。
AI.research_question: 城市内部收入空间分布和通勤模式如何随发展水平变化？
AI.motivation: 理解不同发展阶段城市中空间不平等和通勤模式的差异，以及这些差异对城市贫困人口就业机会获取的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定量城市模型，包含非位似偏好、通勤成本和就业空间集中度等关键因素。
AI.method: 基于121个城市5万个社区的细粒度数据分析，结合定量模型解释跨国家模式。
AI.findings: 发展中国家贫困家庭更可能居住在偏远、地形不利区域；通勤成本随距离增加更快；发展中国家城市贫困人口的就业机会获取明显差于富裕人口，而发达国家相反。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个简洁的定量城市模型，能够解释大部分观察到的跨国家模式，强调了非位似偏好、通勤成本和就业集中度的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划政策提供实证依据，特别是在发展中国家如何改善城市贫困人口的居住条件和就业机会获取。

title: The Global Value of Cities
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD), Northwestern University, University of California, San Diego (UCSD) and University of California, San Diego (UCSD)

detail.title: The Global Value of Cities
detail.abstract:
We estimate the economic value of cities worldwide, using detailed job histories for 513 million workers in 220,000 cities across 191 countries. These estimates allow us to identify why some cities are more productive than others and to quantify the earnings gains from migration throughout the development process. Our data contain job spells—with start and end dates, establishment names, locations, job titles, and effective salaries—enabling an event-study movers design with individual and time fixed effects. Moving to higher-value cities leads to immediate increases in job seniority, shifts into better-paid industries and occupations, and large overall earnings gains. The global scope of the data lets us compare internal and international moves and assess how the productivity advantages of cities differ by country income level. Across borders, 93% of wage changes reflect city effects, while within countries this share ranges from 45–73%. High-income countries exhibit stronger ability-based sorting, reducing the proportion attributable to place. City effects rise with industrial diversity and population, consistent with agglomeration economies, and more productive cities allocate workers to higher-productivity firms. The wide dispersion of city effects within countries highlights substantial potential gains from migration, particularly in low-income, less-urbanized economies. Reallocating workers to match the US distribution yields sizable wage gains in developing countries.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 基于全球5.13亿工人数据的分析显示，迁移到高价值城市能带来显著收入增长，城市效应在国际迁移中贡献93%的工资变化，在各国国内迁移中贡献45-73%。城市生产力优势随产业多样性和人口规模增加，发展中国家通过劳动力重新分配可获得巨大收益。
AI.research_question: 为什么一些城市比其他城市更具生产力？迁移在整个发展过程中能带来多少收入收益？
AI.motivation: 理解城市生产力差异的原因，并量化迁移对个人收入的影响，特别是在不同发展水平国家中的表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集聚经济理论、城市生产力理论、劳动力迁移理论
AI.method: 事件研究移动者设计，使用包含5.13亿工人详细工作历史的全球数据集，采用个体和时间固定效应
AI.findings: 迁移到高价值城市立即提升工作资历、转向高薪行业和职业，带来显著收入增长；城市效应在国际迁移中更强；城市生产力与产业多样性和人口规模正相关；高收入国家基于能力的分类更强
AI.theory_contributions: 量化了城市效应在不同类型迁移中的贡献比例，验证了集聚经济理论在全球范围内的适用性，揭示了城市生产力差异的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家劳动力迁移政策提供依据，显示通过优化劳动力空间分配可获得显著收入提升，特别对低收入、低城市化经济体具有重要政策意义

reference: Banco de Espana Article 2025/Q3, 02; Economic Bulletin, issue 2025/Q3, 2025[10.53479/40286]
title: The role of loans and the ICAS BE in the Eurosystem's collateral framework in 2025
affiliations: Banco de España, Banco de España and Banco de España

detail.title: The role of loans and the ICAS BE in the Eurosystem's collateral framework in 2025

publicationDetails.journalName: Banco de Espana Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This article analyses how the share of non-marketable assets (basically bank loans) pledged as collateral in the Eurosystem's monetary policy credit operations has changed over the last 12 months, homing in on the actual and potential contribution of the Banco de España's in-house credit assessment system (ICAS BE). Takeaways • In the last 12 months the share of non-marketable assets in the collateral pledged by Spanish counterparties in Eurosystem financing operations has held steady, after growing for several years in the wake of the COVID-19 crisis. The proportion of non-marketable assets accounted for by loans to firms assessed using the ICAS BE has continued to grow for the third consecutive year, albeit more moderately. • Counterparties continue to have ample scope to increase the volume of ICAS BE-rated loans pledged, especially in the case of loans to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). • Credit ratings assigned by the ICAS BE to Spanish firms have remained largely unchanged from last year, as higher financing costs have been offset by a slight improvement in the other areas assessed, particularly liquidity.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了过去12个月欧元体系货币政策信贷操作中非市场化资产（主要是银行贷款）作为抵押品的份额变化，重点关注西班牙银行内部信用评估系统（ICAS BE）的实际和潜在贡献。研究发现：非市场化资产份额保持稳定；ICAS BE评估的企业贷款份额持续增长；仍有扩大ICAS BE评级贷款抵押的空间；ICAS BE信用评级基本保持不变。
AI.research_question: 欧元体系货币政策信贷操作中非市场化资产作为抵押品的份额如何变化？西班牙银行内部信用评估系统（ICAS BE）在其中发挥了什么作用？
AI.motivation: 分析COVID-19危机后非市场化资产在欧元体系抵押品中的演变趋势，评估西班牙银行内部信用评估系统的贡献和潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币政策操作中的抵押品管理理论，关注非市场化资产在央行流动性提供中的作用。
AI.method: 实证分析，使用西班牙银行内部信用评估系统（ICAS BE）的数据，分析过去12个月欧元体系信贷操作中抵押品构成的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 非市场化资产份额在COVID-19危机后增长数年后趋于稳定；2. ICAS BE评估的企业贷款份额连续三年增长；3. 仍有扩大ICAS BE评级贷款抵押的空间，特别是中小企业贷款；4. ICAS BE信用评级基本稳定，融资成本上升被流动性改善抵消。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对非市场化资产在央行货币政策操作中作用的理解，为抵押品管理理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为西班牙银行和欧元体系提供了关于抵押品构成变化的实时监测，有助于优化货币政策操作和风险管理策略。

title: Paternalistic Social Assistance: Evidence and Implications from Cash vs. In-Kind Transfers
affiliations: Mount Sinai Health System - Icahn School of Medicine, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Paternalistic Social Assistance: Evidence and Implications from Cash vs. In-Kind Transfers
detail.abstract:
We estimate and compare impacts of cash and in-kind transfers on the consumption of temptation goods in the same population, and explore normative implications. We use two decades of data from South Carolina on cash benefits from Supplemental Security Income (SSI) and in-kind benefits from the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) linked to detailed data on adults’ health care use. Our empirical strategy examines outcome changes in the several days following each transfer’s scheduled monthly payout. Emergency department visits for drug and alcohol use increase by 20-30 percent following SSI receipt, but do not respond to SNAP receipt. Fills of prescription drugs for new illnesses also increase following SSI receipt but do not respond to SNAP receipt. Motivated by these non-fungibility results, we develop a model of a paternalistic social planner choosing the mix of cash and SNAP for a fixed-budget transfer program when consumers have self-control problems and may engage in mental accounting. We show that the planner’s optimal SNAP share is strictly positive and weakly increasing as self-control worsens. Moreover, with heterogeneity in self-control and mental accounting, the planner may choose to use SNAP even when they have access to a uniform Pigouvian tax on the temptation good.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了现金转移支付（SSI）和实物转移支付（SNAP）对诱惑品消费的影响，发现现金转移导致毒品和酒精相关的急诊就诊增加20-30%，而实物转移无此效应。基于此非替代性结果，作者建立了一个包含自我控制问题和心理账户的模型，证明即使在有诱惑品统一税的情况下，社会规划者仍应使用SNAP转移支付。
AI.research_question: 现金转移支付和实物转移支付对诱惑品消费的影响有何差异？在存在自我控制问题和心理账户的情况下，社会规划者应如何设计最优的转移支付组合？
AI.motivation: 理解不同形式转移支付对消费行为的影响，特别是对诱惑品消费的影响，对于设计有效的社会福利政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的自我控制问题、心理账户理论、非替代性消费行为、父爱主义社会规划者模型
AI.method: 使用南卡罗来纳州20年的数据，分析SSI现金转移和SNAP实物转移支付后几天内的急诊就诊和处方药使用变化，采用实证策略检验转移支付对健康相关结果的影响。
AI.findings: 1. SSI现金转移支付后，毒品和酒精相关的急诊就诊增加20-30%；2. SNAP实物转移支付对毒品和酒精相关急诊就诊无显著影响；3. SSI转移支付后新疾病处方药使用增加，SNAP无此效应；4. 转移支付形式存在明显的非替代性效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了包含自我控制问题和心理账户的转移支付选择模型；2. 证明即使存在诱惑品统一税，社会规划者仍应使用SNAP；3. 揭示了转移支付形式对消费行为的异质性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计社会福利转移支付提供了实证依据，建议在存在自我控制问题的群体中优先使用实物转移支付，以减少诱惑品消费的负面后果。

title: Zoom Meetings and Midnight Feedings: Labor Market Change Among Parents of Infants
affiliations: University of Kansas - School of Public Affairs and Administration, University of Kansas - Department of Economics and University of Kansas

detail.title: Zoom Meetings and Midnight Feedings: Labor Market Change Among Parents of Infants
detail.abstract: Raising children is time and resource intensive and, on average, disproportionately influences the daily lives of women. This study builds on already existing evidence showing that, in a society where women are increasingly high-skilled and educated, more flexibility in the timing and location of work increases women's attachment to the labor market. Recent fertility studies have shown a decrease in age at first birth and an increase in births among highly educated women potentially driven by increased work flexibility in white collar jobs. Using a two-year panel from the Current Population Survey, we focus on women who gave birth within the year prior to March 2020 to examine how infant parents shifted labor market behavior after March 2020. We find that highly educated mothers substituted labor market exits, staying in the labor market and increasing leave from work. Fathers substituted increased leave for work time. The ripple effects of this phenomenon on long-term parent-child attachment, as well as child and parent outcomes, should continue to be studied in the future.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在COVID-19疫情期间，高学历母亲通过增加休假而非退出劳动力市场来应对育儿压力，而父亲则通过增加休假来替代工作时间。
AI.research_question: 婴儿父母在2020年3月后如何改变劳动力市场行为？
AI.motivation: 育儿对女性日常生活影响较大，工作灵活性可能增加女性对劳动力市场的依附度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作灵活性理论、生育行为理论、劳动力市场依附理论
AI.method: 使用当前人口调查的两年面板数据，分析在2020年3月前一年内生育的女性
AI.findings: 高学历母亲用增加休假替代退出劳动力市场，父亲用增加休假替代工作时间
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对工作灵活性如何影响父母劳动力市场行为的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定支持工作-家庭平衡的政策提供实证依据

title: Linear Regressions with Combined Data
affiliations: Center for Research in Economics and Statistics (CREST),  and Duke University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Linear Regressions with Combined Data
detail.abstract:
We study linear regressions in a context where the outcome of interest and some of the covariates are observed in two different datasets that cannot be matched. Traditional approaches obtain point identification by relying, often implicitly, on exclusion restrictions. We show that without such restrictions, coefficients of interest can still be partially identified, with the sharp bounds taking a simple form. We obtain tighter bounds when variables observed in both datasets, but not included in the regression of interest, are available, even if these variables are not subject to specific restrictions. We develop computationally simple and asymptotically normal estimators of the bounds. Finally, we apply our methodology to estimate racial disparities in patent approval rates and to evaluate the effect of patience and risk-taking on educational performance.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在结果变量和部分协变量分别出现在两个无法匹配的数据集时的线性回归问题。传统方法依赖排除限制来获得点识别，而本文证明在没有这些限制的情况下，感兴趣的系数仍然可以被部分识别，并获得简单的尖锐边界。当两个数据集中都观测到但未包含在回归中的变量可用时，可以获得更紧的边界。作者开发了计算简单且渐近正态的边界估计量，并应用于估计专利批准率的种族差异以及评估耐心和风险承担对教育表现的影响。
AI.research_question: 在结果变量和部分协变量分别出现在两个无法匹配的数据集的情况下，如何识别线性回归模型中的系数？
AI.motivation: 传统方法依赖排除限制来获得点识别，但在实际应用中这些限制往往不成立或难以验证。需要开发不依赖排除限制的识别方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 部分识别理论，线性回归模型，边界识别方法
AI.method: 开发了在无法匹配数据集情况下的部分识别方法，获得系数的尖锐边界，并提出了计算简单且渐近正态的边界估计量
AI.findings: 在没有排除限制的情况下，系数仍然可以被部分识别，边界具有简单形式。当两个数据集中都观测到但未包含在回归中的变量可用时，可以获得更紧的边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了不依赖排除限制的线性回归系数部分识别方法，扩展了传统点识别框架
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了计算简单的边界估计方法，并应用于估计专利批准率的种族差异以及评估耐心和风险承担对教育表现的影响

title: Target Allocation Funds, Strategic Complementarities, and Market Fragility
affiliations: Drexel University and University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School - Finance Department

detail.title: Target Allocation Funds, Strategic Complementarities, and Market Fragility
detail.abstract:
Target allocation funds (TAFs) make predictable rebalancing trades to maintain portfolio weights across asset classes. During the COVID-19 stock market crash, TAFs sold $59 billion of bond fund shares and simultaneously purchased a similar amount of equity fund shares. We show that TAF rebalancing triggers strategic complementarity: bond mutual funds facing larger rebalancing-induced sales by TAFs experienced greater outflows from other non-TAF investors. This effect was particularly pronounced for illiquid bond funds and amplified total bond fund outflows during COVID-19 by an additional $27 billion. Rebalancing by TAFs, together with the strategic amplification by other investors, transmits equity market shocks to bond returns, accounting for 17% of the rise in stock-bond correlation over the past decade.

AI.tldr: 目标配置基金在COVID-19股市崩盘期间进行了大规模再平衡交易，卖出债券基金买入股票基金，这引发了其他投资者的战略互补行为，放大了债券基金流出，并将股票市场冲击传导至债券市场。
AI.research_question: 目标配置基金的再平衡交易如何影响其他投资者的行为，以及这种机制如何放大金融市场冲击的传导？
AI.motivation: 理解目标配置基金在COVID-19市场危机期间的再平衡行为及其对市场动态的系统性影响，特别是对股票-债券相关性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略互补性理论、市场微观结构理论、资产定价理论
AI.method: 实证分析COVID-19期间目标配置基金的交易数据、债券基金流动数据，以及股票-债券相关性变化
AI.findings: 1) TAF再平衡引发了战略互补性：面临更大TAF卖出压力的债券基金经历了更多非TAF投资者的流出；2) 这种效应在非流动性债券基金中更明显；3) TAF再平衡将股票市场冲击传导至债券回报，解释了17%的股票-债券相关性上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了TAF再平衡触发战略互补性的新机制，解释了机构投资者行为如何放大市场冲击传导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构理解系统性风险传导机制提供了实证依据，帮助投资者更好地管理流动性风险。

title: The Local-Area Incidence of Exporting
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, University of Texas at Austin - Department of Economics and University of Texas at Austin

detail.title: The Local-Area Incidence of Exporting
detail.abstract:
We develop a new algorithm to map confidential firm-level export transactions to their underlying establishments that can be implemented on U.S. microdata. Using this procedure, we construct a novel micro-dataset of U.S. exports at the plant level. Aggregation of these data permits more accurate measurement of exporting at the subnational level (e.g., county, MSA, etc.) than was previously possible. The data reveal exports to be much more geographically concentrated than both employment and manufacturing sales, implying that some regions are heavily reliant on foreign demand. To illustrate the consequences of such exposure, we study the effects of the trade collapse during the Great Recession on local labor markets. Counties experiencing greater declines in foreign demand performed worse in terms of employment, pay, and wages during the Great Recession. A similar analysis implemented with publicly available imputed export data—a common practice in the literature—fails to replicate these estimates.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 开发新算法将企业级出口交易映射到具体工厂，构建美国工厂级出口微观数据集，发现出口比就业和制造业销售更集中，并研究大衰退期间贸易崩溃对地方劳动力市场的影响。

title: Shutting Down Japantown: The Effects of WWII Internment on Japanese American Enclaves
affiliations: Rutgers University and College of William & Mary

detail.title: Shutting Down Japantown: The Effects of WWII Internment on Japanese American Enclaves
detail.abstract:
During World War II, the U.S. government incarcerated all West Coast Japanese Americans in internment camps. We ask how this forced displacement affected Japanese American enclaves. Using the recently digitized 1940 and 1950 full-count censuses, we measure changes in the racial composition of neighborhoods across 14 major cities. We find that internment reduced the Japanese American population of enumeration districts within the exclusion zone by 25–50% relative to their 1940 levels, and that these individuals were replaced by African American in-movers in a nearly 1-to-1 fashion. Outside the exclusion zone, new Japanese American enclaves formed, but did not approach the scale of their historic West Coast counterparts.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 二战期间美国政府对西海岸日裔美国人的强制拘禁导致日裔聚居区人口减少25-50%，这些空缺被非裔美国人以近乎1:1的比例填补，同时在非限制区形成了新的日裔聚居区但规模较小。
AI.research_question: 二战期间强制拘禁如何影响了日裔美国人的聚居区？
AI.motivation: 研究二战期间日裔美国人被强制拘禁这一历史事件对社区构成的长期影响

title: Unraveling the Drivers of Energy-saving Technical Change
affiliations: Northwestern University and Northwestern University

detail.title: Unraveling the Drivers of Energy-saving Technical Change
detail.abstract:
We explore the increasing divergence between economic growth and energy consumption through energy-saving technical progress. Proposing a new measure of energy-saving technology, we study the underlying drivers in a semi-structural model of the U.S. economy. Our analysis shows that energy price shocks reduce consumption and stimulate energy-saving innovation, but also cause economic downturns and crowd out other innovations. Only energy-saving technology shocks can explain the negative co-movement between output and energy use. These sudden efficiency gains emerge as the primary driver of energy-saving technical change. Our findings highlight the importance of fostering energy-saving innovations in transitioning to a low-carbon economy.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过能源节约型技术进步探讨经济增长与能源消费之间的日益分化。提出新的能源节约技术衡量方法，在美国经济半结构模型中研究其驱动因素。研究发现能源价格冲击会减少消费并刺激能源节约创新，但也会导致经济衰退并挤出其他创新。只有能源节约技术冲击能解释产出与能源使用之间的负相关。突然的效率提升是能源节约技术变革的主要驱动力。
AI.research_question: 能源节约型技术进步如何驱动经济增长与能源消费之间的分化？
AI.motivation: 经济增长与能源消费之间日益扩大的差距需要理解其背后的技术驱动因素，这对向低碳经济转型具有重要意义。

AI.method: 提出新的能源节约技术衡量方法，使用美国经济的半结构模型进行分析
AI.findings: 能源价格冲击会减少能源消费并刺激能源节约创新，但会导致经济衰退和挤出其他创新；只有能源节约技术冲击能解释产出与能源使用的负相关；突然的效率提升是主要驱动力

AI.practical_contributions: 强调了在向低碳经济转型过程中培育能源节约创新的重要性，为政策制定提供理论依据

title: Dilution vs. Risk Taking: Capital Gains Taxes and Entrepreneurship
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School, University of Zurich, National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), University of Pennsylvania - Business & Public Policy Department and University of Zurich - Department of Finance

detail.title: Dilution vs. Risk Taking: Capital Gains Taxes and Entrepreneurship
detail.abstract:
Recent proposals to tax unrealized capital gains or wealth have sparked a debate about their impact on entrepreneurship. We show that accrual-based taxation creates two opposing effects: successful founders face greater dilution from advance tax payments, whereas unsuccessful founders receive tax credits that effectively provide insurance. Using comprehensive new data on U.S. venture capital deals, we find that founder returns remain extremely skewed, with 84% receiving zero exit value while the top 2% capture 80% of total value. Moving from current realization-based to accrual-based taxation would reduce founder ownership at exit by 25% on average but would also increase the fraction receiving positive payoffs from 16% to 47% when tax credits are refunded. Embedding these distributions in a dynamic career choice model, we find that founders with no or moderate risk aversion prefer the current realization-based tax system, while more risk-averse founders prefer accrual-based taxation. We estimate that a 2% annual wealth tax has a similar impact on dilution as taxing unrealized capital gains but produces no risk-sharing benefits due to the absence of tax credits in case of down rounds.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了未实现资本利得税对创业的影响，发现应计制税收会产生两种相反效应：成功创始人面临更大稀释，而不成功创始人获得税收抵免保险。基于美国风险投资数据，研究发现从实现制转向应计制税收会使创始人退出所有权平均减少25%，但获得正回报的比例从16%升至47%。风险规避程度不同的创始人偏好不同税收制度。
AI.research_question: 未实现资本利得税或财富税对创业活动的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 近期关于对未实现资本利得或财富征税的提议引发了关于其对创业影响的辩论

AI.method: 使用美国风险投资交易的全面新数据，结合动态职业选择模型进行分析
AI.findings: 创始人回报极度偏斜，84%获得零退出价值，前2%获得80%总价值。从实现制转向应计制税收使创始人退出所有权平均减少25%，但获得正回报比例从16%升至47%。风险规避程度不同的创始人偏好不同税收制度。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了应计制税收对创业的双重效应：稀释效应和保险效应，为税收政策设计提供了理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于不同税收制度对创业影响的实证证据，有助于设计更合理的创业税收政策

title: The Evolution of Macroprudential Policy in Chinese Real Estate Market (2015-2024)

detail.title: The Evolution of Macroprudential Policy in Chinese Real Estate Market (2015-2024)
detail.abstract: Financial stability is a critical component of economic health, with real estate markets often serving as both barometers and catalysts of macroeconomic impulse. From this view, macroprudential policy has been evolving as a key regulatory approach to address systemic risks following the 2008 financial crisis, with particular attention to housing markets due to their procyclicality and strong linkages to financial systems. In emerging economies like China, where real estate accounts for approximately 20% of GDP, understanding the dynamics between sectoral financial conditions and broader economic activity is crucial for effective policy design, yet measuring these relationships has been challenging due to complex interplay and diverse understanding of monetary policy transmission channels and market expectations. The specific challenge this study addresses is the lack of sector-specific financial condition indices capable of capturing the temporal dynamics and causal relationships between real estate financial conditions and broader economic activity in China's unique financial system. Here we show that our constructed Real Estate Financial Condition Index (RE-FCI) demonstrates statistically significant lead-lag and directional causal relationships with the Li Keqiang Index, a proxy for Chinese economic activity. Contrary to conventional wisdom that treats financial condition indices primarily as descriptive tools, our analysis reveals that the RE-FCI serves as a leading indicator of economic activity with a 7-month lead time (correlation = -0.37), while also participating in a feedback loop where economic conditions influence real estate financial conditions with a quarterly delay. The robustness of these causal relationships across multiple analytical frameworks (standard PCMCI, robust PCMCI, and ensemble approaches) validates the RE-FCI's transition from a descriptive metric to a predictive instrument with genuine policy relevance. Our findings provide empirical evidence that sector-specific financial condition monitoring can enhance the precision and timeliness of macroprudential policies, potentially preventing the amplification of economic cycles through real estate markets. These insights contribute to the discourse on Chinese financial stability by demonstrating how advanced analytical techniques can transform sectoral indicators into actionable policy tools, with possible implications extending beyond China to other emerging economies facing similar challenges in managing real estate-driven economic cycles.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了中国房地产金融状况指数(RE-FCI)，发现该指数作为经济活动的领先指标具有7个月领先期，并与李克强指数存在双向因果关系，为宏观审慎政策提供了实证依据。
AI.research_question: 如何衡量中国房地产金融状况与更广泛经济活动之间的时间动态和因果关系？

AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观审慎政策理论、金融状况指数理论、房地产市场的顺周期性和与金融体系的强关联性
AI.method: 构建房地产金融状况指数(RE-FCI)，使用多种分析框架（标准PCMCI、稳健PCMCI和集成方法）检验因果关系
AI.findings: RE-FCI作为经济活动的领先指标具有7个月领先期（相关系数=-0.37），同时参与反馈循环，经济状况以季度延迟影响房地产金融状况
AI.theory_contributions: 将部门特定的金融状况指数从描述性工具转变为具有真正政策相关性的预测工具，展示了高级分析技术如何将部门指标转化为可操作的政策工具
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观审慎政策提供实证证据，表明部门特定的金融状况监测可以提高政策的精确性和及时性，可能防止通过房地产市场放大经济周期

title: From Regeneration to Coherence: The Origin of the Planetary Innovation Ecology

detail.title: From Regeneration to Coherence: The Origin of the Planetary Innovation Ecology
detail.abstract:
From Regeneration to Coherence traces the emergence of Planetary Innovation Ecology (PIE) — a new philosophy and science of innovation grounded in Earth’s aliveness. Drawing from lived experimentation across clean technology, distributed manufacturing, and systemic design, the paper explores how humanity’s models of innovation remain largely incremental, confined to anthropocentric paradigms of regeneration and optimization. It argues that the next paradigm demands a transition from regeneration to coherence — a state in which human creativity realigns with the organizing logic of living systems.

While systems thinkers such as Capra and Luisi articulated the living-systems view of life, and Earth-system scientists like Folke and Rockström mapped planetary boundaries, none have treated innovation itself as a living ecological process or proposed ways to measure its alignment with planetary intelligence. Planetary Innovation Ecology fills this gap. It defines innovation as a co-evolutionary phenomenon within the biosphere and introduces two new instruments — the Planetary Coherence Index and the Planetary Symbiosis Index — to assess how human systems evolve toward reciprocal thriving with Earth. Together, these ideas form the groundwork for a new planetary science of innovation — one in which invention becomes participation in the evolutionary intelligence of life itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了行星创新生态学（PIE）作为基于地球生命性的新创新哲学和科学，主张从再生转向一致性，使人类创造力与生命系统的组织逻辑重新对齐。
AI.research_question: 如何将创新本身视为生态过程，并衡量其与行星智慧的一致性？
AI.motivation: 现有创新模型局限于人类中心的再生和优化范式，需要向与生命系统组织逻辑一致的新范式转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行星创新生态学、生命系统观、行星边界理论、共进化现象
AI.method: 基于清洁技术、分布式制造和系统设计的实际实验
AI.findings: 开发了行星一致性指数和行星共生指数来评估人类系统如何与地球实现互惠繁荣
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将创新视为生态过程，提出了衡量创新与行星智慧一致性的新理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为创新实践提供了新的评估工具，使发明成为参与生命进化智慧的过程

title: The health and economic costs of welfare reform: a quasi-experimental evaluation of the roll-out of Universal Credit in England
affiliations: University of Lausanne - Department of Economics, The University of Manchester - School of Health Sciences, University of Liverpool - Department of Public Health, Policy and Systems, Newcastle University - Population Health Sciences Institute, University of Liverpool - Department of Public Health, Policy and Systems, University of Glasgow - MRC/CSO Social and Public Health Sciences Unit, Lancaster University, Northumbria University, University of Glasgow - Institute of Health and Wellbeing, University of Glasgow - Institute of Health and Wellbeing, University of Liverpool, Newcastle University, University of Essex, University of Liverpool - Department of Public Health, Policy and Systems and The University of Manchester

detail.title: The health and economic costs of welfare reform: a quasi-experimental evaluation of the roll-out of Universal Credit in England
detail.abstract: We provide new evidence on the mental health and care service impacts of the roll-out of Universal Credit, one of the most significant welfare reforms in Europe in recent decades. Designed to simplify benefits and strengthen work incentives by merging six means-tested programmes into a single payment, Universal Credit also introduced stress-inducing features that may harm mental health, including stringent conditionality, sanctions, a five-week wait for the first payment, and greater financial management burdens. Exploiting the plausibly exogenous, staggered geographical introduction of Universal Credit across England (2013-2018), we implement a staggered difference-in-differences framework using comprehensive administrative data from the Small Area Mental Health Index at Lower-layer Super Output Area level. We find substantial adverse effects: a 0.10 SD increase in clinically diagnosed depression prevalence, a 0.03 SD rise in mental health-related hospital admissions and attendances, and a 0.06 SD increase in antidepressant prescribing. In natural units, these correspond to about 113,742 additional depression cases, 29,993 extra hospital admissions and attendances, and 1.29 million more antidepressant prescriptions annually by 2018. Effects are immediate and persistent, larger for areas exposed earlier, and increase with local uptake. Results are robust across specifications, sensitivity analyses, and alternative estimators. Indicative valuations imply sizeable societal and healthcare costs of approximately £2.84 billion annually, indicating important externalities of the reform. These findings underscore the need to incorporate mental health and care service consequences into the design, implementation, and evaluation of welfare policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现英国全民信贷福利改革导致心理健康显著恶化，包括抑郁症患病率增加、精神健康相关住院就诊上升、抗抑郁药处方增多，每年造成约28.4亿英镑的社会和医疗成本。
AI.research_question: 全民信贷福利改革对心理健康和医疗服务使用有何影响？
AI.motivation: 全民信贷是欧洲近几十年来最重要的福利改革之一，旨在简化福利并加强工作激励，但同时也引入了可能损害心理健康的压力因素，如严格条件性、制裁、五周等待期和更大财务负担。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利用福利改革对心理健康的潜在负面影响理论，特别是压力诱导机制和财务困境对心理健康的影响。
AI.method: 采用交错双重差分框架，利用2013-2018年英格兰地区全民信贷分阶段地理引入的外生变化，使用小区域心理健康指数的综合行政数据。
AI.findings: 全民信贷导致临床诊断抑郁症患病率增加0.10个标准差，精神健康相关住院就诊增加0.03个标准差，抗抑郁药处方增加0.06个标准差。按自然单位计算，相当于每年增加约113,742例抑郁症、29,993次住院就诊和129万份抗抑郁药处方。
AI.theory_contributions: 为福利改革对心理健康影响提供了强有力的因果证据，强调了政策设计中心理健康考量的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了全民信贷改革的重要外部性成本，为政策制定者提供了将心理健康和医疗服务后果纳入福利政策设计、实施和评估的依据。
